title: S$^2$-RL: Sample-Set Dual Reinforcement Learning for Generative Semantic Segmentation Dataset Distillation
title_zh: S²-RL：面向生成式语义分割数据集蒸馏的样本集双重强化学习

paragraphs.en: While dataset distillation has witnessed significant advances in image classification, its extension to dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation is plagued by two core bottlenecks: bi-level optimization-based approaches suffer from prohibitive computational costs stemming from pixel-wise gradient unrolling, whereas proxy-based generative methods merely infuse visual textures into fixed semantic masks derived from real data, thus failing to condense rich semantic knowledge into a compact set of informative, novel scene generations. To address both bottlenecks simultaneously, we propose a novel Sample-Set Reinforcement Learning (S 2 -RL) framework for generative semantic segmentation dataset distillation (SSDD). Specifically, S 2 -RL formulates SSDD as a diffusion model based text-to-image generation paradigm, enabling flexible generation of images with informative, novel semantic distributions via a concise text prompt. Furthermore, we fine-tune a diffusion policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), leveraging a sample-set dual reward paradigm: for individual samples, it enforces semantic alignment with input text prompts and intra-class feature diversity; for sample sets, it maximizes inter-sample semantic distribution diversity by solving a contextual multi-armed bandit problem. These design choices enable S 2 -RL to distill large-scale semantic segmentation datasets into a compact set of generated samples that encapsulate diverse, informative semantic knowledge without the need of pixel-wise gradient unrolling. Extensive experiments on the ADE20K and COCO datasets demonstrate that S 2 -RL achieves substantial and consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines, establishing a new benchmark for SSDD.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管数据集蒸馏在图像分类领域已取得显著进展，但其向语义分割等密集预测任务的扩展仍受制于两大核心瓶颈：基于双层优化的方法因逐像素梯度展开而产生难以承受的计算开销，而基于代理的生成式方法仅将视觉纹理注入从真实数据派生的固定语义掩码中，因而无法将丰富的语义知识浓缩为一组紧凑且信息丰富的新颖场景生成结果。 为同时解决这两大瓶颈，我们提出了一种用于生成式语义分割数据集蒸馏（SSDD）的新型样本集强化学习（S 2 -RL）框架。 具体而言，S 2 -RL 将 SSDD 建模为基于扩散模型的文本到图像生成范式，能够通过简洁的文本提示灵活生成具有信息丰富的新颖语义分布的图像。 此外，我们通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）微调扩散策略，并利用样本集双重奖励范式：对单个样本，它强制实现与输入文本提示的语义对齐以及类内特征多样性；对样本集，它通过求解一个上下文多臂老虎机问题来最大化样本间语义分布多样性。 这些设计选择使 S 2 -RL 能够将大规模语义分割数据集蒸馏为一组紧凑的生成样本，这些样本蕴含多样且信息丰富的语义知识，且无需逐像素梯度展开。 在 ADE20K 和 COCO 数据集上的大量实验表明，S 2 -RL 相较于最先进的基线方法取得了显著且一致的提升，为 SSDD 树立了新的基准。

paragraphs.en: Data-efficient learning has become crucial as deep learning models grow increasingly data-hungry. Dataset distillation [ 40 ] addresses this by condensing massive datasets into compact synthetic surrogates. Existing advances in dataset distillation fall into two primary paradigms: optimization-based methods and proxy-based generative methods. While both paradigms yield strong performance on image classification, their extension to dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation remains fraught with substantial challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 随着深度学习模型对数据的需求日益增长，数据高效学习变得至关重要。 数据集蒸馏 [ 40 ] 通过将海量数据集压缩为紧凑的合成替代品来应对这一问题。 数据集蒸馏的现有进展主要分为两大范式：基于优化的方法和基于代理的生成式方法。 尽管这两种范式在图像分类任务上都取得了出色的性能，但将其扩展到语义分割等密集预测任务仍面临诸多重大挑战。

sents.en: Data-efficient learning has become crucial as deep learning models grow increasingly data-hungry.
sents.zh: 随着深度学习模型对数据的需求日益增长，数据高效学习变得至关重要。

sents.en: Dataset distillation [ 40 ] addresses this by condensing massive datasets into compact synthetic surrogates.
sents.zh: 数据集蒸馏 [ 40 ] 通过将海量数据集压缩为紧凑的合成替代品来应对这一问题。

sents.en: Existing advances in dataset distillation fall into two primary paradigms: optimization-based methods and proxy-based generative methods.
sents.zh: 数据集蒸馏的现有进展主要分为两大范式：基于优化的方法和基于代理的生成式方法。

sents.en: While both paradigms yield strong performance on image classification, their extension to dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation remains fraught with substantial challenges.
sents.zh: 尽管这两种范式在图像分类任务上都取得了出色的性能，但将其扩展到语义分割等密集预测任务仍面临诸多重大挑战。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, optimization-based methods (Figure 1(a) ), such as gradient matching [ 48 , 3 , 50 ] and distribution matching [ 39 , 49 , 28 ] , formulate dataset distillation as a bi-level optimization problem aiming to align the gradients or distributions of student models on synthetic data with those on the real counterpart. While theoretically rigorous, these methods suffer from computational intractability in semantic segmentation tasks. Unlike image classification, which only relies on sparse supervision, semantic segmentation requires unrolling pixel-wise gradients at full spatial resolution, leading to severe memory overhead and making end-to-end optimization practically infeasible.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，基于优化的方法（图1(a)），如梯度匹配 [48, 3, 50] 和分布匹配 [39, 49, 28]，将数据集蒸馏形式化为一个双层优化问题，旨在使智能体模型在合成数据上的梯度或分布与在真实数据上的梯度或分布保持一致。 尽管这些方法在理论上严谨，但在语义分割任务中存在计算上难以处理的问题。 与仅依赖稀疏监督的图像分类不同，语义分割需要在完整空间分辨率下展开逐像素的梯度，这会导致严重的内存开销，使得端到端优化在实际中不可行。

paragraphs.en: To circumvent this memory bottleneck, proxy-based generative methods [ 45 , 35 ] (Figure 1(b) ) have emerged as an efficient alternative, which bypass bi-level optimization via data inversion or global statistic matching. Since global statistics matching cannot comprehensively depict the complex spatial arrangements of multiple categories, existing approaches, such as those for object detection [ 27 ] or universal dataset distillation [ 26 ] , turn to rely on fixed spatial masks from real data for structural regularization. This strategy reduces the model to a mere texture filler within static boundaries, rather than a genuine scene composer, and thus fails to synthesize a compact set of novel, informative spatial layouts necessary for covering the long-tail distributions of real-world scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 为绕过这一内存瓶颈，基于代理的生成方法 [45, 35]（图 1(b)）已成为一种高效的替代方案，其通过数据反演或全局统计量匹配来规避双层优化。 由于全局统计量匹配无法全面刻画多个类别间复杂的空间排布，现有方法（如面向目标检测 [27] 或通用数据集蒸馏 [26] 的方法）转而依赖来自真实数据的固定空间掩码来进行结构正则化。 这种策略把模型降格为静态边界内单纯的纹理填充器，而非真正的场景构图者，因而无法合成一组紧凑的、新颖且信息丰富的空间布局，而这些布局对于覆盖现实世界场景的长尾分布是必不可少的。

paragraphs.en: To bridge these gaps, we propose a novel S ample- S et R einforcement L earning (S 2 -RL) framework for generative semantic segmentation dataset distillation (SSDD), as shown in Figure 1(c) . Unlike existing gradient-heavy or mask-conditioned methods, we reformulate SSDD as a diffusion-based text-to-image generation paradigm and optimize it through reward-driven reinforcement learning without pixel-wise gradient unrolling through downstream segmentation training. By framing the generative model as an agent, S 2 -RL directly utilizes appropriate rewards to drive policy updates. This framework not only eliminates the need for heavy second-order gradient computations, but also empowers the model to flexibly synthesize a compact set of images with novel, informative contents from concise text prompts, thus enabling effective SSDD.
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥补这些差距，我们提出了一种新颖的样本集强化学习（S²-RL）框架，用于生成式语义分割数据集蒸馏（SSDD），如图1(c)所示。 与现有依赖大量梯度或以掩码为条件的方法不同，我们将SSDD重新表述为基于扩散的文本到图像生成范式，并通过奖励驱动的强化学习对其进行优化，而无需在下游分割训练中进行逐像素梯度展开。 通过将生成模型视为智能体，S²-RL直接利用适当的奖励来驱动策略更新。 该框架不仅消除了对繁重二阶梯度计算的需求，还使模型能够根据简洁的文本提示灵活地合成一小组具有新颖信息内容的图像，从而实现有效的SSDD。

paragraphs.en: However, applying RL to generative dataset distillation introduces a new challenge. Standard RL methods (e.g., DDPO [ 2 ] , Flow-GRPO [ 21 , 38 ] ) are typically designed for sample-level optimization, aiming to maximize the quality of individual instances. In contrast, dataset distillation is fundamentally a set-level optimization problem: the objective is to construct a collective dataset that covers the original dataset distribution with fewer samples. Straightforwardly applying standard RL is prone to incur model collapse, where the model over-optimizes for easy patterns while ignoring the long-tail distribution characteristics of real datasets. To address this problem, we introduce a sample-set dual reward mechanism. At the sample-level, for each individual generated sample, we enforce semantic alignment with the input prompt while penalizing collapsed local textures within the same class. At the set-level, we maximize inter-sample semantic distribution diversity by solving a contextual multi-armed bandit problem, enabling the generated compact sample set to appropriately cover the original long-tail dataset distribution. Empirical evaluations on ADE20K [ 51 ] and COCO [ 20 ] benchmarks demonstrate that S 2 -RL outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reconciling generation quality with distributional diversity.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，将强化学习应用于生成式数据集蒸馏会带来一个新的挑战。 标准的强化学习方法（例如 DDPO [ 2 ] 、Flow-GRPO [ 21 , 38 ] ）通常是为样本级优化设计的，旨在最大化单个样本实例的质量。 相比之下，数据集蒸馏本质上是一个集合级优化问题：其目标是构建一个以更少样本覆盖原始数据集分布的集合数据集。 直接应用标准强化学习容易引发模型坍缩，即模型对简单模式过度优化，而忽视了真实数据集的长尾分布特性。 为解决这一问题，我们引入了一种样本-集合双重奖励机制。 在样本级，对于每个生成的单独样本，我们强制其与输入提示保持语义对齐，同时惩罚同类中发生坍缩的局部纹理。 在集合级，我们通过求解一个上下文多臂老虎机问题来最大化样本间语义分布的多样性，使生成的紧凑样本集能够恰当地覆盖原始的长尾数据集分布。 在 ADE20K [ 51 ] 和 COCO [ 20 ] 基准上的实证评估表明，S 2 -RL 优于最先进的基线方法，实现了生成质量与分布多样性的调和统一。

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose S 2 -RL, a novel generative dataset distillation framework that leverages RL to enable efficient image synthesis for dense prediction tasks, bypassing the memory bottlenecks of explicit gradient matching.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 S²-RL，一种新颖的生成式数据集蒸馏框架，利用强化学习为密集预测任务实现高效的图像合成，从而绕过显式梯度匹配的内存瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: We design a dual reward mechanism that balances sample quality and set diversity, mitigating semantic mode collapse.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一种双重奖励机制，以平衡样本质量与集合多样性，从而缓解语义模式坍塌问题。

paragraphs.en: We obtain new state-of-the-art SSDD performance on ADE20K and COCO datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ADE20K 和 COCO 数据集上获得了新的最先进 SSDD 性能。

paragraphs.en: Coreset Selection. This paradigm selects a representative subset from the original data. Classical methods include random selection, which samples data stochastically, and uniform selection, which ensures balanced sampling across categories. Beyond these, geometry-based methods leverage feature space structures. Herding [ 41 , 6 ] selects samples closest to the cluster center of each class to approximate the mean of the distribution. Conversely, K-Center [ 11 , 30 ] aims to minimize the maximum distance between any data point and the selected subset, effectively prioritizing boundary samples to maximize geometric coverage. While efficient, these extraction-based methods are inherently bounded by the finite samples available in the source domain, limiting their ability to bridge distributional gaps through synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 核心集选择。 该范式从原始数据中选取一个具有代表性的子集。 经典方法包括随机选择，即对数据进行随机抽样，以及均匀选择，即确保跨类别的均衡采样。 除此之外，基于几何的方法利用特征空间结构。 Herding [ 41 , 6 ] 选择最接近每个类别的聚类中心的样本，以近似该分布的均值。 相反，K-Center [ 11 , 30 ] 旨在最小化任意数据点与所选子集之间的最大距离，实际上是优先选择边界样本以最大化几何覆盖范围。 这些基于提取的方法虽然高效，但本质上受限于源域中可用的有限样本，从而限制了它们通过合成来弥合分布差异的能力。

sents.en: Coreset Selection.
sents.zh: 核心集选择。

sents.en: This paradigm selects a representative subset from the original data.
sents.zh: 该范式从原始数据中选取一个具有代表性的子集。

sents.en: Classical methods include random selection, which samples data stochastically, and uniform selection, which ensures balanced sampling across categories.
sents.zh: 经典方法包括随机选择，即对数据进行随机抽样，以及均匀选择，即确保跨类别的均衡采样。

sents.en: Beyond these, geometry-based methods leverage feature space structures.
sents.zh: 除此之外，基于几何的方法利用特征空间结构。

sents.en: Herding [ 41 , 6 ] selects samples closest to the cluster center of each class to approximate the mean of the distribution.
sents.zh: Herding [ 41 , 6 ] 选择最接近每个类别的聚类中心的样本，以近似该分布的均值。

sents.en: Conversely, K-Center [ 11 , 30 ] aims to minimize the maximum distance between any data point and the selected subset, effectively prioritizing boundary samples to maximize geometric coverage.
sents.zh: 相反，K-Center [ 11 , 30 ] 旨在最小化任意数据点与所选子集之间的最大距离，实际上是优先选择边界样本以最大化几何覆盖范围。

sents.en: While efficient, these extraction-based methods are inherently bounded by the finite samples available in the source domain, limiting their ability to bridge distributional gaps through synthesis.
sents.zh: 这些基于提取的方法虽然高效，但本质上受限于源域中可用的有限样本，从而限制了它们通过合成来弥合分布差异的能力。

paragraphs.en: Optimization-based Dataset Distillation. To synthesize informative data, early methods formulated dataset distillation as a bi-level optimization problem. Gradient matching methods [ 48 , 3 , 50 ] align the gradients or long-term training dynamics of student and teacher models, while distribution matching methods [ 39 , 49 , 28 ] optimize distribution or feature statistics. Differentiable augmentation [ 47 ] , neural feature regression [ 52 ] , and difficulty-aligned trajectory matching [ 14 ] further advance classification distillation. Extending such methods to high-resolution dense prediction remains challenging. In particular, approaches that differentiate through student training face prohibitive memory costs when unrolling pixel-wise computation graphs.
paragraphs.zh: 基于优化的数据集蒸馏。 为了合成信息丰富的数据，早期方法将数据集蒸馏表述为一个双层优化问题。 梯度匹配方法 [48, 3, 50] 对齐学生模型与教师模型的梯度或长期训练动态，而分布匹配方法 [39, 49, 28] 优化分布或特征统计量。 可微分增强 [47]、神经特征回归 [52] 以及难度对齐的轨迹匹配 [14] 进一步推动了分类蒸馏的发展。 将此类方法扩展到高分辨率密集预测仍然具有挑战性。 特别是，那些在学生模型训练过程中进行求导的方法，在展开逐像素计算图时会面临高昂的内存开销。

paragraphs.en: Proxy-based Generative Dataset Distillation. To bypass the heavy optimization, recent works have shifted towards proxy-based generative methods. Model inversion methods [ 45 , 9 , 32 ] invert pretrained model statistics (e.g., BatchNorm) to recover training images. Generative attempts [ 35 , 4 , 53 ] leverage the rich priors of generative models to synthesize diverse data distributions by matching global statistics or embedding alignments. Minimax Diffusion [ 13 ] additionally balances representativeness and diversity during generative training. However, a critical gap remains when transferring these successes to semantic segmentation. Due to the lack of spatial location information in global statistics, existing methods, such as those for object detection [ 27 ] or universal distillation [ 26 ] , typically require pre-defined layouts from real data to constrain the generation process. This dependency limits the synthesized dataset to the topological variations already in the training set, hindering the exploration of novel scene layouts.
paragraphs.zh: 基于代理的生成式数据集蒸馏。 为了绕开繁重的优化，近期的工作已转向基于代理的生成式方法。 模型反演方法 [ 45 , 9 , 32 ] 通过对预训练模型的统计量（例如 BatchNorm）进行反演来恢复训练图像。 生成式尝试 [ 35 , 4 , 53 ] 利用生成模型丰富的先验，通过匹配全局统计量或嵌入对齐来合成多样的数据分布。 Minimax Diffusion [ 13 ] 额外在生成训练过程中平衡代表性与多样性。 然而，将这些成功经验迁移到语义分割时仍存在一个关键差距。 由于全局统计量缺乏空间位置信息，现有方法（例如面向目标检测的方法 [ 27 ] 或通用蒸馏方法 [ 26 ] ）通常需要来自真实数据的预定义布局来约束生成过程。 这种依赖性将合成数据集限制在训练集中已有的拓扑变化上，阻碍了对新场景布局的探索。

paragraphs.en: Unlike optimization methods that face computational barriers, or proxy methods that depend on static mask priors, S 2 -RL adopts a reward-driven policy optimization paradigm. This allows for the autonomous construction of complex scene topologies without unrolling downstream student-training gradients or using fixed masks as generation conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 与面临计算瓶颈的优化方法，或依赖静态掩码先验的代理方法不同，S2-RL 采用了一种奖励驱动的策略优化范式。 这使得无需展开下游学生训练梯度，也无需使用固定掩码作为生成条件，就能自主构建复杂的场景拓扑结构。

sents.en: Unlike optimization methods that face computational barriers, or proxy methods that depend on static mask priors, S 2 -RL adopts a reward-driven policy optimization paradigm.

sents.en: This allows for the autonomous construction of complex scene topologies without unrolling downstream student-training gradients or using fixed masks as generation conditions.
sents.zh: 这使得无需展开下游学生训练梯度，也无需使用固定掩码作为生成条件，就能自主构建复杂的场景拓扑结构。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement Learning has recently been integrated with diffusion models to align generation with specific objectives. DDPO [ 2 ] treats the multi-step denoising process as a policy, enabling the optimization of non-differentiable reward functions via policy gradient. DPO-Diffusion [ 37 ] simplifies this by leveraging preference pairs to optimize the policy without an explicit reward model. To further enhance training stability, Flow-GRPO [ 21 , 38 ] estimates gradients using the relative advantage of sampled groups, eliminating the need for a separate value network.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习近来已被与扩散模型相结合，以使生成过程与特定目标对齐。 DDPO [ 2 ] 将多步去噪过程视为一个智能体，通过策略梯度实现对不可微奖励函数的优化。 DPO-Diffusion [ 37 ] 通过利用偏好对来优化策略而无需显式的奖励模型，从而简化了这一过程。 为进一步提升训练稳定性，Flow-GRPO [ 21 , 38 ] 使用采样组的相对优势来估计梯度，从而无需单独的价值网络。

paragraphs.en: While these methods have successfully improved sample quality, they primarily focus on sample-level optimization. In the context of dataset distillation, our S 2 -RL extends these frameworks to a set-level perspective, utilizing RL not just for individual image quality, but to actively explore and cover the diverse semantic distribution required for robust downstream training.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然这些方法已成功提升了样本质量，但它们主要聚焦于样本层面的优化。 在数据集蒸馏的背景下，我们的 S 2 -RL 将这些框架扩展到集合层面的视角，不仅利用强化学习提升单张图像的质量，还主动探索并覆盖鲁棒的下游训练所需的多样化语义分布。

paragraphs.en: While sample-level rewards improve individual images, they do not account for the semantic modes covered by other generated samples. To address this, we reformulate the set-level diversity optimization as a contextual multi-armed bandit (MAB) problem [ 34 ] , where the diffusion policy acts as the agent, the prompt c c serves as the context, and the arms are defined as the discrete collection of semantic prototypes specifically constructed for each category. Our objective is to encourage balanced arm visitation within each class, guiding the agent to cover diverse semantic modes rather than repeatedly exploiting frequent prototypes. To operationalize this discrete bandit framework within a continuous generative space, we introduce three key components: Semantic Arm Construction to discretize the feature space into class-specific prototypes; Robust State-Action Mapping to identify the pulled arms from generated images; and Entropy-Maximizing Reward Mechanism to incentivize the exploration of scarce prototypes.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然样本级别的奖励能改进单张图像，但它们并未考虑其他生成样本所覆盖的语义模式。 为解决这一问题，我们将集合级别的多样性优化重新表述为上下文多臂老虎机（MAB）问题 [ 34 ]，其中扩散策略充当智能体，提示 c c 充当上下文，而臂则被定义为针对每个类别专门构建的语义原型离散集合。 我们的目标是促进每个类别内各臂的均衡访问，引导智能体覆盖多样的语义模式，而非反复利用频繁出现的原型。 为了在连续生成空间中实现这一离散老虎机框架，我们引入了三个关键组件：用于将特征空间离散化为类别特定原型的语义臂构建；用于从生成图像中识别被拉动臂的鲁棒状态-动作映射；以及用于激励探索稀缺原型的熵最大化奖励机制。

sents.en: Our objective is to encourage balanced arm visitation within each class, guiding the agent to cover diverse semantic modes rather than repeatedly exploiting frequent prototypes.
sents.zh: 我们的目标是促进每个类别内各臂的均衡访问，引导智能体覆盖多样的语义模式，而非反复利用频繁出现的原型。

sents.en: To operationalize this discrete bandit framework within a continuous generative space, we introduce three key components: Semantic Arm Construction to discretize the feature space into class-specific prototypes; Robust State-Action Mapping to identify the pulled arms from generated images; and Entropy-Maximizing Reward Mechanism to incentivize the exploration of scarce prototypes.
sents.zh: 为了在连续生成空间中实现这一离散老虎机框架，我们引入了三个关键组件：用于将特征空间离散化为类别特定原型的语义臂构建；用于从生成图像中识别被拉动臂的鲁棒状态-动作映射；以及用于激励探索稀缺原型的熵最大化奖励机制。

paragraphs.en: Semantic Arm Construction. To define a finite set of semantic arms, we perform an offline discretization of the real data manifold. We employ DINOv3 [ 33 ] to pool normalized features within real class regions using ground-truth training masks. For each category k k , K-means with K = 50 K=50 centers partitions the region features, and each center is mapped to its nearest observed same-class region feature. These representatives form the discrete arm set 𝒫 k \mathcal{P}_{k} , serving as the reference for set-level coverage. If fewer than K K regions are available, all are retained. Appendix D.4 compares this construction with random same-class representatives.
paragraphs.zh: 语义臂构建。 为了定义一个有限的语义臂集合，我们对真实数据流形进行离线离散化。 我们采用 DINOv3 [33] 使用真值训练掩码在真实类别区域内池化归一化特征。 对于每个类别 k k，使用 K=50 个中心的 K-means 对区域特征进行划分，并将每个中心映射到其最近的同类别已观测区域特征。 这些代表构成离散臂集合 𝒫 k \mathcal{P}_{k}，作为集合级覆盖的参考。 如果可用区域少于 K 个，则全部保留。 附录 D.4 将此构建方式与随机的同类别代表进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Optimization Behavior. The combined reward objective biases the policy toward prompt-consistent, feature-diverse, and semantically well-covered samples, discouraging degenerate solutions by jointly leveraging sample-level quality rewards and a set-level coverage reward. We refer readers to Proposition 5 in Appendix A for a detailed interpretation.

paragraphs.en: Datasets and Metrics. We evaluate our framework on two challenging benchmarks: ADE20K [ 51 ] and COCO [ 20 ] . For COCO, we utilize the panoptic annotations converted into semantic segmentation masks to ensure high-quality pixel-wise supervision. As one of the first systematic studies of dataset distillation specifically tailored to semantic segmentation, we establish a standardized evaluation protocol adapted from the image classification task’s images per class (IPC) metric; specifically, considering the multi-class nature of segmentation images, we determine the data budget based on global compression ratios rather than fixed class counts. Accordingly, we set the ratios to 0.25%, 0.5%, 1.0% for ADE20K and 0.625‰, 1.25‰, 2.5‰ for the larger COCO dataset to align with standard distillation scales (e.g., 10/20/50 IPC). We report mean intersection over union (mIoU) and mean pixel accuracy (mAcc) as the primary metrics. For the main comparisons, we construct 5 dataset groups and train 5 student seeds per group, reporting mean and standard deviation over the 25 downstream runs.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集与评估指标。 我们在两个具有挑战性的基准上评估我们的框架：ADE20K [ 51 ] 和 COCO [ 20 ]。 对于 COCO，我们利用转换为语义分割掩码的全景标注，以确保高质量的逐像素监督。 作为首批专门针对语义分割的数据集蒸馏系统性研究之一，我们基于图像分类任务中的每类图像数（IPC）指标建立了一套适配的标准化评估协议；具体而言，考虑到分割图像的多类别特性，我们基于全局压缩比例而非固定的类别数来确定数据预算。 相应地，我们将 ADE20K 的比例设置为 0.25%、0.5%、1.0%，将规模更大的 COCO 数据集的比例设置为 0.625‰、1.25‰、2.5‰，以与标准蒸馏规模（例如 10/20/50 IPC）保持一致。 我们报告平均交并比（mIoU）和平均像素准确率（mAcc）作为主要指标。 对于主要对比实验，我们构建 5 个数据集组，每组训练 5 个学生模型随机种子，并在 25 次下游运行中报告均值和标准差。

paragraphs.en: Baselines. We compare S 2 -RL with two categories of baselines: (1) coreset selection methods: We include Random selection, Uniform sampling (class-balanced), K-Center [ 11 , 30 ] , and Herding [ 41 , 6 ] . We employ a pretrained ResNet-50 [ 15 ] to extract deep features for distance computation in K-Center and Herding. (2) generative baselines: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium (SD3.5) [ 10 ] serves as our vanilla generative baseline, and UniDD ∗ [ 26 ] denotes our reproduced UniDD-inspired proxy-guided segmentation baseline. Implementation details of UniDD ∗ are provided in Appendix B.2 .

paragraphs.en: Implementation Details. (1) RL and Set Construction: We employ Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium [ 10 ] as the policy backbone, fine-tuned via LoRA [ 17 ] with a rank of 32. To construct the text conditioning, we utilize the image subset selected by the Uniform baseline. Specifically, we extract all category names present in each selected image and concatenate them into a comma-separated string (e.g., “person, car, tree”) to serve as the multi-category prompt. The policy is optimized using AdamW [ 24 ] at learning rate 1e-4. After policy adaptation, we generate candidate images and screen them using the same sample-level and set-level reward functions used in training. A pretrained teacher model then supplies pixel-wise pseudo-labels for the retained images. (2) Evaluation Stage: We independently train a student on each synthesized dataset using MMSegmentation [ 8 ] . Our default student is SegFormer-B5 [ 43 ] , whose MiT-B5 backbone is initialized from ImageNet-1K-pretrained weights for each run. The models are trained for 200 epochs using the AdamW optimizer with a crop size of 512 × 512 512\times 512 . Additional architectural variations are detailed in the ablation studies.
paragraphs.zh: 实现细节。 （1）强化学习与集合构建：我们采用 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium [ 10 ] 作为策略骨干网络，通过 LoRA [ 17 ] 进行微调，秩为 32。 为构建文本条件，我们利用由 Uniform 基线选出的图像子集。 具体而言，我们提取每张被选图像中出现的所有类别名称，并将其拼接为一个以逗号分隔的字符串（例如 “person, car, tree”），作为多类别提示。 策略使用 AdamW [ 24 ] 进行优化，学习率为 1e-4。 在策略适配完成后，我们生成候选图像，并使用与训练阶段相同的样本级和集合级奖励函数对其进行筛选。 随后，一个预训练的教师模型为保留的图像提供像素级伪标签。 （2）评估阶段：我们使用 MMSegmentation [ 8 ] 在每个合成数据集上独立训练一个学生模型。 我们默认的学生模型为 SegFormer-B5 [ 43 ] ，其 MiT-B5 骨干网络在每次运行时均从 ImageNet-1K 预训练权重初始化。 模型使用 AdamW 优化器训练 200 个 epoch，裁剪尺寸为 512 × 512 512\times 512 。 其他架构上的变化在消融实验中详细说明。

sents.en: Implementation Details.
sents.zh: 实现细节。

sents.en: (1) RL and Set Construction: We employ Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium [ 10 ] as the policy backbone, fine-tuned via LoRA [ 17 ] with a rank of 32.
sents.zh: （1）强化学习与集合构建：我们采用 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium [ 10 ] 作为策略骨干网络，通过 LoRA [ 17 ] 进行微调，秩为 32。

sents.en: To construct the text conditioning, we utilize the image subset selected by the Uniform baseline.
sents.zh: 为构建文本条件，我们利用由 Uniform 基线选出的图像子集。

sents.en: Specifically, we extract all category names present in each selected image and concatenate them into a comma-separated string (e.g., “person, car, tree”) to serve as the multi-category prompt.
sents.zh: 具体而言，我们提取每张被选图像中出现的所有类别名称，并将其拼接为一个以逗号分隔的字符串（例如 “person, car, tree”），作为多类别提示。

sents.en: The policy is optimized using AdamW [ 24 ] at learning rate 1e-4.
sents.zh: 策略使用 AdamW [ 24 ] 进行优化，学习率为 1e-4。

sents.en: After policy adaptation, we generate candidate images and screen them using the same sample-level and set-level reward functions used in training.
sents.zh: 在策略适配完成后，我们生成候选图像，并使用与训练阶段相同的样本级和集合级奖励函数对其进行筛选。

sents.en: A pretrained teacher model then supplies pixel-wise pseudo-labels for the retained images.
sents.zh: 随后，一个预训练的教师模型为保留的图像提供像素级伪标签。

sents.en: (2) Evaluation Stage: We independently train a student on each synthesized dataset using MMSegmentation [ 8 ] .
sents.zh: （2）评估阶段：我们使用 MMSegmentation [ 8 ] 在每个合成数据集上独立训练一个学生模型。

sents.en: Our default student is SegFormer-B5 [ 43 ] , whose MiT-B5 backbone is initialized from ImageNet-1K-pretrained weights for each run.
sents.zh: 我们默认的学生模型为 SegFormer-B5 [ 43 ] ，其 MiT-B5 骨干网络在每次运行时均从 ImageNet-1K 预训练权重初始化。

sents.en: The models are trained for 200 epochs using the AdamW optimizer with a crop size of 512 × 512 512\times 512 .
sents.zh: 模型使用 AdamW 优化器训练 200 个 epoch，裁剪尺寸为 512 × 512 512\times 512 。

sents.en: Additional architectural variations are detailed in the ablation studies.
sents.zh: 其他架构上的变化在消融实验中详细说明。

paragraphs.en: Quantitative Analysis. Tables and 1 present the results on ADE20K and COCO, where S 2 -RL consistently achieves the best performance among the compared methods across all compression ratios. Compared with coreset selection strategies, the advantage is particularly evident at low data ratios, where limited image budgets make redundancy more costly. While selection draws from a fixed pool of real images, S 2 -RL shapes the semantic content and coverage of new training examples through reward-guided synthesis. The DINOv3-based coreset comparison in Appendix D.1 provides a complementary evaluation with stronger selection features. S 2 -RL also demonstrates a clear advantage over the generative baseline. This highlights the role of RL-driven alignment: while SD3.5 possesses strong general visual priors, S 2 -RL steers generation toward informative supervision for downstream semantic segmentation. Additional controls appear in Appendix B.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 定量分析。 表和 1 展示了在 ADE20K 和 COCO 上的结果，其中 S²-RL 在所有压缩比率下都持续取得优于对比方法的最佳性能。 与核心集选择策略相比，其优势在低数据比率下尤为明显，因为有限的图像预算使冗余的代价更高。 选择方法依赖于固定的真实图像池，而 S²-RL 则通过奖励引导的合成来塑造新训练样本的语义内容与覆盖范围。 附录 D.1 中基于 DINOv3 的核心集比较利用更强的选择特征提供了补充评估。 S²-RL 相对于生成式基线也展现出明显优势。 这凸显了强化学习驱动对齐的作用：尽管 SD3.5 具有强大的通用视觉先验，S²-RL 能将生成引导至对下游语义分割具有信息量的监督方向。 更多控制实验见附录 B.6。

paragraphs.en: Qualitative Analysis. We visualize the latent feature distributions in Figure . A pretrained ResNet-50 extracts class-wise embeddings for Real Data ( ), the Uniform Selection Baseline ( ), and S 2 -RL ( ). In these projections, Uniform samples concentrate around densely populated regions, whereas S 2 -RL samples occupy broader regions of the class-wise feature space. This pattern is consistent with the set-level reward, which favors underrepresented semantic prototypes alongside sample-level quality. For a compact segmentation dataset, covering a wider range of class-specific appearances can provide more varied supervision within the same image budget.

paragraphs.en: Semantic and Layout Coverage. To complement the feature-space visualization, Table 3 evaluates spatial occupancy, category co-occurrence, and relative geometry using a frozen OneFormer [ 18 ] outside the reward pipeline. Occupancy describes where each class appears, category pairs capture which classes occur together, and relative geometry describes their spatial relationships. The same annotator is applied to generated images and held-out real references. S 2 -RL broadens occupancy and relative-geometry coverage while increasing category-pair recall. Images containing the same categories can still differ in object placement and relative scale. Covering these configurations exposes the student to varied spatial contexts within a fixed image budget. The category-pair results also reveal a coverage–precision trade-off as the range of generated combinations expands. These complementary measurements connect the distributional view to semantic content and scene organization relevant to dense prediction. Definitions and complete results appear in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 语义与布局覆盖。 为补充特征空间可视化，表 3 使用一个冻结的 OneFormer [18]（在奖励流程之外）评估空间占用、类别共现和相对几何。 占用描述每个类别出现的位置，类别对捕捉哪些类别一起出现，相对几何描述它们的空间关系。 同一标注器被应用于生成图像和留出的真实参考图像。 S²-RL 在提高类别对召回率的同时，拓宽了占用和相对几何的覆盖范围。 包含相同类别的图像在物体摆放和相对尺度上仍可能不同。 覆盖这些配置使学生在固定的图像预算内接触到多样的空间上下文。 类别对的结果还揭示了随着生成组合范围扩大而出现的覆盖—精度权衡。 这些互补的度量将分布视角与与密集预测相关的语义内容和场景组织联系起来。 定义与完整结果见附录 E。

paragraphs.en: Component Effectiveness Analysis. To evaluate the contribution of each design element, we incrementally add: 1) Alignment ( R a ​ l ​ i ​ g ​ n R_{align} ), 2) Diversity ( R d ​ i ​ v R_{div} ), and 3) Set ( R s ​ e ​ t R_{set} ). Table 4 shows consistent gains from combining these components across the evaluated data ratios. While R a ​ l ​ i ​ g ​ n R_{align} establishes the semantic foundation for prompt adherence, R d ​ i ​ v R_{div} encourages feature variation within class regions, reducing local redundancy. The set reward extends this optimization across images by favoring prototypes underrepresented in the generation history. The results highlight the complementary roles of local sample quality and cross-sample coverage. In a highly compressed dataset, this complementarity helps each image provide useful local supervision while contributing to semantic modes that other images cover less well.
paragraphs.zh: 组件有效性分析。 为了评估每个设计元素的贡献，我们逐步添加：1) 对齐（R_{align}），2) 多样性（R_{div}），以及 3) 集合（R_{set}）。 表4显示，在所评估的各数据比例下，组合这些组件带来了一致的增益。 R_{align} 为提示词遵循奠定了语义基础，而 R_{div} 则鼓励类别区域内的特征变化，减少局部冗余。 集合奖励通过偏好生成历史中欠代表的原型，将这一优化扩展到跨图像层面。 结果突出了局部样本质量与跨样本覆盖的互补作用。 在高度压缩的数据集中，这种互补性有助于每张图像提供有用的局部监督，同时贡献于其他图像覆盖较少的语义模式。

paragraphs.en: Robustness and Generalization. Table 2 demonstrates the versatility of S 2 -RL across three dimensions. First, regarding model capacity (Group a), gains persist from ResNet-18 to ResNet-101, showing that the compact dataset supports learning across model scales. Second, regarding backbone architectures (Group b), the benefits extend to both ConvNeXt [ 23 ] and Swin Transformer [ 22 ] . Third, regarding segmentation mechanisms (Group c), improvements also appear with DeepLabV3 [ 5 ] and SegFormer [ 43 ] , indicating compatibility with different decoding designs. Together, these results show that the same distilled image–mask pairs provide useful supervision across the tested student configurations, allowing a compact dataset to be reused for different model requirements. Additional analyses of independent policy-training variability and prototype construction are provided in Appendices D.3 and D.4 , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 鲁棒性与泛化能力。 表 2 展示了 S 2 -RL 在三个维度上的通用性。 首先，在模型容量方面（组 a），从 ResNet-18 到 ResNet-101 均有提升，表明该紧凑数据集能够支持跨模型规模的学习。 其次，在骨干网络架构方面（组 b），其优势同样体现在 ConvNeXt [ 23 ] 和 Swin Transformer [ 22 ] 上。 第三，在分割机制方面（组 c），DeepLabV3 [ 5 ] 和 SegFormer [ 43 ] 上也出现了改进，表明其与不同的解码设计兼容。 总之，这些结果表明，同一组蒸馏的图像–掩码对在各种被测的学生模型配置下都能提供有效的监督，使这一紧凑数据集可以复用于不同的模型需求。 关于独立策略训练变异性和原型构建的补充分析分别见附录 D.3 和 D.4。

paragraphs.en: Semantic Richness. We assess data quality with the complex-scene examples in Figure 3 . While the SD3.5 baseline generates texturally plausible images, it often omits objects requested in dense prompts, such as specific furniture in Row 4 or distinct vehicles in Row 2. In contrast, S 2 -RL synthesizes scenes with higher semantic density, retaining richer structure and detail, from the foliage in Row 1 to the cluttered interior decor in Row 4. Such multi-category scenes provide supervision for several semantic regions and their shared context within each training image. This is valuable for dense prediction, where the student learns object appearance together with its surrounding scene structure. Preserving requested objects also retains boundaries between semantic regions, providing supervision for class transitions alongside region appearance. The qualitative examples complement the category co-occurrence and relative-geometry measurements in Table 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 语义丰富度。 我们使用图 3 中的复杂场景示例来评估数据质量。 虽然 SD3.5 基线生成的图像在纹理上是合理的，但它经常遗漏密集提示词中所要求的目标，例如第 4 行中的特定家具或第 2 行中的不同车辆。 相比之下，S 2 -RL 合成的场景具有更高的语义密度，保留了更丰富的结构和细节，从第 1 行的植被到第 4 行中杂乱的室内装饰。 这样的多类别场景为每张训练图像中的多个语义区域及其共享上下文提供了监督信号。 这对密集预测任务很有价值，在该任务中，学生模型需要同时学习目标外观及其周围的场景结构。 保留所要求的目标也保留了语义区域之间的边界，从而在提供区域外观监督的同时，还提供了类别过渡的监督。 这些定性示例补充了表 3 中的类别共现和相对几何度量。

sents.zh: 相比之下，S 2 -RL 合成的场景具有更高的语义密度，保留了更丰富的结构和细节，从第 1 行的植被到第 4 行中杂乱的室内装饰。

sents.en: Such multi-category scenes provide supervision for several semantic regions and their shared context within each training image.
sents.zh: 这样的多类别场景为每张训练图像中的多个语义区域及其共享上下文提供了监督信号。

sents.en: This is valuable for dense prediction, where the student learns object appearance together with its surrounding scene structure.
sents.zh: 这对密集预测任务很有价值，在该任务中，学生模型需要同时学习目标外观及其周围的场景结构。

sents.en: Preserving requested objects also retains boundaries between semantic regions, providing supervision for class transitions alongside region appearance.
sents.zh: 保留所要求的目标也保留了语义区域之间的边界，从而在提供区域外观监督的同时，还提供了类别过渡的监督。

paragraphs.en: We propose S 2 -RL, a generative framework for semantic segmentation dataset distillation that fine-tunes Stable Diffusion via GRPO with a sample-set dual reward, integrating sample-level fidelity and set-level coverage to bypass the computational bottlenecks of bi-level optimization and the static-prior limitation of proxy-based methods. Experiments on ADE20K and COCO show consistent state-of-the-art gains, and our RL-driven paradigm offers a scalable path toward distillation for broader dense-prediction tasks. The framework incurs an upfront policy-adaptation cost and depends on pretrained generative and segmentation priors. Its rewards approximate downstream utility, and pseudo-labels may inherit teacher errors on rare or ambiguous categories. Future work could reduce adaptation and sampling costs, improve pseudo-label reliability through uncertainty-aware annotation, and incorporate lightweight student feedback to better align reward optimization with segmentation performance without full gradient unrolling.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 S²-RL，一个用于语义分割数据集蒸馏的生成式框架，该框架通过带有样本集双重奖励的 GRPO 对 Stable Diffusion 进行微调，融合样本级保真度与集合级覆盖度，从而绕过双层优化的计算瓶颈以及基于代理的方法的静态先验局限。 在 ADE20K 和 COCO 上的实验显示了一致的最先进性能提升，且我们由强化学习驱动的范式为更广泛的密集预测任务的蒸馏提供了一条可扩展的路径。 该框架会产生前期策略适配成本，并依赖于预训练的生成与分割先验。 其奖励是对下游效用的近似，且伪标签在稀有或模糊类别上可能继承教师模型的错误。 未来的工作可以降低适配与采样成本，通过不确定性感知的标注提高伪标签的可靠性，并引入轻量级的学生反馈，以在不进行完整梯度展开的情况下，使奖励优化与分割性能更好地对齐。

sents.en: The total reward introduces three complementary optimization effects:
sents.zh: 总奖励引入了三种互补的优化效应：

paragraphs.en: Semantic alignment. By Proposition 1 , prompt-inconsistent samples receive lower relative advantages, which reduces their relative likelihood compared with semantically valid alternatives generated for the same prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 语义对齐。 根据命题 1，与提示词不一致的样本会获得较低的相对优势，这降低了它们相对于为同一提示词生成的语义有效备选方案的相对可能性。

sents.en: Semantic alignment.
sents.zh: 语义对齐。

sents.en: By Proposition 1 , prompt-inconsistent samples receive lower relative advantages, which reduces their relative likelihood compared with semantically valid alternatives generated for the same prompt.
sents.zh: 根据命题 1，与提示词不一致的样本会获得较低的相对优势，这降低了它们相对于为同一提示词生成的语义有效备选方案的相对可能性。

paragraphs.en: Feature diversity. By Proposition 2 , repetitive intra-class feature structures receive lower diversity rewards, which discourages low-information textures and encourages more discriminative local structures.
paragraphs.zh: 特征多样性。 根据命题2，重复的类内特征结构会获得较低的多样性奖励，这抑制了低信息量的纹理，并鼓励更具判别性的局部结构。

sents.en: Feature diversity.
sents.zh: 特征多样性。

sents.en: By Proposition 2 , repetitive intra-class feature structures receive lower diversity rewards, which discourages low-information textures and encourages more discriminative local structures.
sents.zh: 根据命题2，重复的类内特征结构会获得较低的多样性奖励，这抑制了低信息量的纹理，并鼓励更具判别性的局部结构。

paragraphs.en: Set-level coverage. By Propositions 3 and 4 , under-covered semantic prototypes receive larger set-level rewards, creating a negative feedback mechanism that promotes broader prototype coverage over the distilled set.
paragraphs.zh: 集合级覆盖率。 根据命题 3 和命题 4，覆盖不足的语义原型会获得更大的集合级奖励，从而形成一种负反馈机制，促进对蒸馏集合的更广泛的原型覆盖。

sents.en: Set-level coverage.
sents.zh: 集合级覆盖率。

sents.en: By Propositions 3 and 4 , under-covered semantic prototypes receive larger set-level rewards, creating a negative feedback mechanism that promotes broader prototype coverage over the distilled set.
sents.zh: 根据命题 3 和命题 4，覆盖不足的语义原型会获得更大的集合级奖励，从而形成一种负反馈机制，促进对蒸馏集合的更广泛的原型覆盖。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, the sample-level rewards improve the local quality of individual generated images, while the set-level reward encourages global semantic coverage across the generated set. The combined objective does not impose exact uniformity or guarantee perfect convergence, but it provides a principled optimization bias toward informative and diverse dense-prediction training samples. ∎
paragraphs.zh: 因此，样本级奖励提升单个生成图像的局部质量，而集合级奖励则鼓励生成的图像集合在整体上实现全局语义覆盖。 组合目标并不强求完全的均匀性，也不保证完美收敛，但它提供了一种有原则的优化偏向，引导生成信息丰富且多样的密集预测训练样本。∎

paragraphs.en: In this section, we provide the comprehensive hyperparameter settings and architectural details required to reproduce our experiments. Our framework is implemented using PyTorch and the Diffusers library [ 36 ] based on GRPO Guard [ 38 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们提供了复现我们的实验所需的完整超参数设置和架构细节。 我们的框架基于 GRPO Guard [ 38 ]，使用 PyTorch 和 Diffusers 库 [ 36 ] 实现。

paragraphs.en: Policy Model. We utilize Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium [ 10 ] as our backbone policy π θ \pi_{\theta} . To ensure training efficiency and prevent catastrophic forgetting of the pretrained generative priors, we adopt low-rank adaptation (LoRA) [ 17 ] for fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 策略模型。 我们采用 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium [10] 作为主干策略 π θ \pi_{\theta}。 为确保训练效率并防止预训练生成先验发生灾难性遗忘，我们采用低秩适配（LoRA）[17] 进行微调。

sents.en: Policy Model.
sents.zh: 策略模型。

sents.en: We utilize Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium [ 10 ] as our backbone policy π θ \pi_{\theta} .
sents.zh: 我们采用 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium [10] 作为主干策略 π θ \pi_{\theta}。

paragraphs.en: Base Model: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium (2.5B parameters).
paragraphs.zh: 基础模型：Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium（25亿参数）。

paragraphs.en: LoRA Configuration: We inject LoRA layers into the attention mechanisms of the MMDiT. The LoRA rank is set to 32, with an alpha value of 64.
paragraphs.zh: LoRA 配置：我们将 LoRA 层注入到 MMDiT 的注意力机制中。 LoRA 的秩设置为 32，alpha 值为 64。

paragraphs.en: Trainable Parameters: Only the LoRA weights ( ∼ \sim 70 MB) are updated during the RL phase.
paragraphs.zh: 可训练参数：在强化学习（RL）阶段仅更新 LoRA 权重（约 70 MB）。

paragraphs.en: Reward Models. Our dual-reward mechanism relies on three types of frozen pretrained models, each playing a distinct role:
paragraphs.zh: 奖励模型。 我们的双重奖励机制依赖三种类型的冻结预训练模型，各自扮演不同的角色：

sents.en: Reward Models.
sents.zh: 奖励模型。

sents.en: Our dual-reward mechanism relies on three types of frozen pretrained models, each playing a distinct role:
sents.zh: 我们的双重奖励机制依赖三种类型的冻结预训练模型，各自扮演不同的角色：

paragraphs.en: Semantic Evaluator Ensemble. For ADE20K we use UPerNet-ConvNeXt-Large [ 42 , 23 ] , SegFormer-B5 [ 43 ] , and DPT-Large [ 29 ] ; for COCO we use Mask2Former-Swin-Large [ 7 ] , EOMT-Large [ 19 ] , and EOMT-Base. Each frozen evaluator computes alignment from its own mask and diversity from its own intermediate feature grid, using at most 100 locations per predicted class. We sum the resulting scalar sample rewards. Raw feature vectors from different architectures are never compared. Per-pixel majority voting combines the masks only for DINOv3 region pooling in the set-level reward.
paragraphs.zh: 语义评估器集成。 对于 ADE20K，我们使用 UPerNet-ConvNeXt-Large [ 42 , 23 ]、SegFormer-B5 [ 43 ] 和 DPT-Large [ 29 ]；对于 COCO，我们使用 Mask2Former-Swin-Large [ 7 ]、EOMT-Large [ 19 ] 和 EOMT-Base。 每个冻结的评估器根据其自身的掩码计算一致性，并根据其自身的中间特征网格计算多样性，每个预测类别最多使用 100 个位置。 我们对由此得到的标量样本奖励进行求和。 来自不同架构的原始特征向量永远不会被比较。 在集合级奖励中，逐像素多数投票仅用于 DINOv3 的区域池化来组合掩码。

sents.en: Semantic Evaluator Ensemble.
sents.zh: 语义评估器集成。

sents.en: For ADE20K we use UPerNet-ConvNeXt-Large [ 42 , 23 ] , SegFormer-B5 [ 43 ] , and DPT-Large [ 29 ] ; for COCO we use Mask2Former-Swin-Large [ 7 ] , EOMT-Large [ 19 ] , and EOMT-Base.
sents.zh: 对于 ADE20K，我们使用 UPerNet-ConvNeXt-Large [ 42 , 23 ]、SegFormer-B5 [ 43 ] 和 DPT-Large [ 29 ]；对于 COCO，我们使用 Mask2Former-Swin-Large [ 7 ]、EOMT-Large [ 19 ] 和 EOMT-Base。

sents.en: Each frozen evaluator computes alignment from its own mask and diversity from its own intermediate feature grid, using at most 100 locations per predicted class.
sents.zh: 每个冻结的评估器根据其自身的掩码计算一致性，并根据其自身的中间特征网格计算多样性，每个预测类别最多使用 100 个位置。

sents.en: We sum the resulting scalar sample rewards.
sents.zh: 我们对由此得到的标量样本奖励进行求和。

sents.en: Raw feature vectors from different architectures are never compared.
sents.zh: 来自不同架构的原始特征向量永远不会被比较。

sents.en: Per-pixel majority voting combines the masks only for DINOv3 region pooling in the set-level reward.
sents.zh: 在集合级奖励中，逐像素多数投票仅用于 DINOv3 的区域池化来组合掩码。

paragraphs.en: Pseudo-Label Teacher. The downstream student is trained on synthesized images paired with pseudo-labels produced by a single, stronger frozen segmentor: UPerNet-ConvNeXt-XLarge for ADE20K and Mask2Former-Swin-Large for COCO. The same teacher is used to label images from all synthetic baselines (SD3.5, UniDD ∗ , and S 2 -RL), so the annotation procedure and downstream training protocol are shared across methods.
paragraphs.zh: 伪标签教师。 下游学生在合成图像上训练，其配对的伪标签由单个更强的冻结分割器生成：ADE20K 使用 UPerNet-ConvNeXt-XLarge，COCO 使用 Mask2Former-Swin-Large。 所有合成基线（SD3.5、UniDD ∗ 和 S 2 -RL）的图像标注均使用同一个教师，因此各方法共享相同的标注流程和下游训练协议。

sents.en: Pseudo-Label Teacher.
sents.zh: 伪标签教师。

sents.en: The downstream student is trained on synthesized images paired with pseudo-labels produced by a single, stronger frozen segmentor: UPerNet-ConvNeXt-XLarge for ADE20K and Mask2Former-Swin-Large for COCO.
sents.zh: 下游学生在合成图像上训练，其配对的伪标签由单个更强的冻结分割器生成：ADE20K 使用 UPerNet-ConvNeXt-XLarge，COCO 使用 Mask2Former-Swin-Large。

sents.en: The same teacher is used to label images from all synthetic baselines (SD3.5, UniDD ∗ , and S 2 -RL), so the annotation procedure and downstream training protocol are shared across methods.
sents.zh: 所有合成基线（SD3.5、UniDD ∗ 和 S 2 -RL）的图像标注均使用同一个教师，因此各方法共享相同的标注流程和下游训练协议。

paragraphs.en: Feature Extractor. The set-level reward (Eq. 7 ) is computed on dense patch features from a frozen DINOv3 ViT-L model [ 33 ] . The semantic mask from the segmentor ensemble is downsampled by nearest-neighbor interpolation to match the DINOv3 patch grid, and DINOv3 features are L 2 -normalized along the channel dimension before any cosine-similarity computation. DINOv3 is used only for semantic-arm construction and matching in R s ​ e ​ t R_{set} .
paragraphs.zh: 特征提取器。 集合级奖励（式 7）基于冻结的 DINOv3 ViT-L 模型 [33] 提取的稠密图块特征计算。 来自分割器集成（segmentor ensemble）的语义掩码通过最近邻插值进行下采样，以匹配 DINOv3 的图块网格，并且在任何余弦相似度计算之前，DINOv3 特征会沿通道维度进行 L2 归一化。 DINOv3 仅用于 R_{set} 中语义分支的构建与匹配。

sents.en: Feature Extractor.
sents.zh: 特征提取器。

sents.en: The set-level reward (Eq. 7 ) is computed on dense patch features from a frozen DINOv3 ViT-L model [ 33 ] .
sents.zh: 集合级奖励（式 7）基于冻结的 DINOv3 ViT-L 模型 [33] 提取的稠密图块特征计算。

sents.en: The semantic mask from the segmentor ensemble is downsampled by nearest-neighbor interpolation to match the DINOv3 patch grid, and DINOv3 features are L 2 -normalized along the channel dimension before any cosine-similarity computation.
sents.zh: 来自分割器集成（segmentor ensemble）的语义掩码通过最近邻插值进行下采样，以匹配 DINOv3 的图块网格，并且在任何余弦相似度计算之前，DINOv3 特征会沿通道维度进行 L2 归一化。

sents.en: DINOv3 is used only for semantic-arm construction and matching in R s ​ e ​ t R_{set} .
sents.zh: DINOv3 仅用于 R_{set} 中语义分支的构建与匹配。

paragraphs.en: We implement a UniDD-inspired proxy-guided baseline as an additional generative comparison. UniDD [ 26 ] uses task-specific proxy models to extract task-relevant supervision and guide diffusion-based dataset distillation. Since the official UniDD implementation is not publicly available, we implement a segmentation-oriented proxy-guided baseline using a released pretrained FreestyleNet [ 44 ] checkpoint as the layout-to-image generator, while following the proxy-guided sampling and refinement principle of UniDD. This implementation corresponds to the UniDD ∗ entries in Table and Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们实现了一个受 UniDD 启发的代理引导基线，作为额外的生成式对比方法。 UniDD [ 26 ] 使用任务特定的代理模型来提取与任务相关的监督信号，并指导基于扩散的数据集蒸馏。 由于 UniDD 的官方实现并未公开，我们使用已发布的预训练 FreestyleNet [ 44 ] 检查点作为布局到图像生成器，实现了一个面向分割的代理引导基线，同时遵循 UniDD 的代理引导采样与细化原则。 该实现对应表和表 1 中的 UniDD ∗ 条目。

sents.en: We implement a UniDD-inspired proxy-guided baseline as an additional generative comparison.
sents.zh: 我们实现了一个受 UniDD 启发的代理引导基线，作为额外的生成式对比方法。

sents.en: UniDD [ 26 ] uses task-specific proxy models to extract task-relevant supervision and guide diffusion-based dataset distillation.
sents.zh: UniDD [ 26 ] 使用任务特定的代理模型来提取与任务相关的监督信号，并指导基于扩散的数据集蒸馏。

sents.en: Since the official UniDD implementation is not publicly available, we implement a segmentation-oriented proxy-guided baseline using a released pretrained FreestyleNet [ 44 ] checkpoint as the layout-to-image generator, while following the proxy-guided sampling and refinement principle of UniDD.
sents.zh: 由于 UniDD 的官方实现并未公开，我们使用已发布的预训练 FreestyleNet [ 44 ] 检查点作为布局到图像生成器，实现了一个面向分割的代理引导基线，同时遵循 UniDD 的代理引导采样与细化原则。

sents.en: This implementation corresponds to the UniDD ∗ entries in Table and Table 1 .
sents.zh: 该实现对应表和表 1 中的 UniDD ∗ 条目。

paragraphs.en: The proxy-guided baseline initializes generation from the masks selected by the Uniform baseline. This keeps the layout source and compression budget aligned with the real-data subset baselines, while replacing the corresponding real images with generated images. FreestyleNet takes dense semantic layouts as conditions and synthesizes images aligned with the input masks, making it suitable for adapting proxy-guided generation to semantic segmentation.
paragraphs.zh: 代理引导的基线从由均匀基线选择的掩码开始进行生成。 这使布局来源和压缩预算与真实数据子集基线保持一致，同时将对应的真实图像替换为生成图像。 FreestyleNet 以密集语义布局为条件，合成与输入掩码对齐的图像，因此适合将代理引导的生成适配到语义分割任务。

sents.en: The proxy-guided baseline initializes generation from the masks selected by the Uniform baseline.
sents.zh: 代理引导的基线从由均匀基线选择的掩码开始进行生成。

sents.en: This keeps the layout source and compression budget aligned with the real-data subset baselines, while replacing the corresponding real images with generated images.
sents.zh: 这使布局来源和压缩预算与真实数据子集基线保持一致，同时将对应的真实图像替换为生成图像。

sents.en: FreestyleNet takes dense semantic layouts as conditions and synthesizes images aligned with the input masks, making it suitable for adapting proxy-guided generation to semantic segmentation.
sents.zh: FreestyleNet 以密集语义布局为条件，合成与输入掩码对齐的图像，因此适合将代理引导的生成适配到语义分割任务。

paragraphs.en: The proxy segmentation model is dataset-specific. For ADE20K, we use SegFormer-B0 as the proxy segmentation model. For COCO, we use MaskFormer-R50 as the proxy segmentation model. During generation, the proxy model scores the semantic consistency between the generated image and the input mask, and this score is used for refinement and filtering. After image generation, we use the same pseudo-labeling teacher as S 2 -RL to obtain pixel-wise annotations, so that all synthetic baselines are evaluated with the same downstream training pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 代理分割模型是特定于数据集的。 对于 ADE20K，我们使用 SegFormer-B0 作为代理分割模型。 对于 COCO，我们使用 MaskFormer-R50 作为代理分割模型。 在生成过程中，代理模型对生成图像与输入掩码之间的语义一致性进行评分，该评分用于精炼和过滤。 在图像生成之后，我们使用与 S 2 -RL 相同的伪标注教师来获取像素级标注，从而使所有合成基线都在相同的下游训练流程下进行评估。

sents.en: The proxy segmentation model is dataset-specific.
sents.zh: 代理分割模型是特定于数据集的。

sents.en: For ADE20K, we use SegFormer-B0 as the proxy segmentation model.
sents.zh: 对于 ADE20K，我们使用 SegFormer-B0 作为代理分割模型。

sents.en: For COCO, we use MaskFormer-R50 as the proxy segmentation model.
sents.zh: 对于 COCO，我们使用 MaskFormer-R50 作为代理分割模型。

sents.en: During generation, the proxy model scores the semantic consistency between the generated image and the input mask, and this score is used for refinement and filtering.
sents.zh: 在生成过程中，代理模型对生成图像与输入掩码之间的语义一致性进行评分，该评分用于精炼和过滤。

sents.en: After image generation, we use the same pseudo-labeling teacher as S 2 -RL to obtain pixel-wise annotations, so that all synthetic baselines are evaluated with the same downstream training pipeline.
sents.zh: 在图像生成之后，我们使用与 S 2 -RL 相同的伪标注教师来获取像素级标注，从而使所有合成基线都在相同的下游训练流程下进行评估。

paragraphs.en: We follow the original UniDD hyperparameter setting as closely as possible. Each image is generated with 250 sampling steps. The filtering threshold is set to 0.75. A generated image is accepted if its proxy score exceeds this threshold. If the proxy score remains below the threshold for three consecutive attempts, we keep the highest-scoring image among the attempted samples. This fallback rule preserves a fixed dataset size for every compression ratio and prevents failed generations from changing the number of downstream training images.
paragraphs.zh: 我们尽可能遵循原始 UniDD 的超参数设置。 每张图像使用 250 个采样步数生成。 过滤阈值设置为 0.75。 如果生成图像的代理分数超过该阈值，则该图像被接受。 如果代理分数在连续三次尝试中仍低于阈值，我们保留尝试样本中得分最高的图像。 这一回退规则确保每个压缩比下的数据集大小固定，并防止生成失败改变下游训练图像的数量。

sents.en: We follow the original UniDD hyperparameter setting as closely as possible.
sents.zh: 我们尽可能遵循原始 UniDD 的超参数设置。

sents.en: Each image is generated with 250 sampling steps.
sents.zh: 每张图像使用 250 个采样步数生成。

sents.en: The filtering threshold is set to 0.75.
sents.zh: 过滤阈值设置为 0.75。

sents.en: A generated image is accepted if its proxy score exceeds this threshold.
sents.zh: 如果生成图像的代理分数超过该阈值，则该图像被接受。

sents.en: If the proxy score remains below the threshold for three consecutive attempts, we keep the highest-scoring image among the attempted samples.
sents.zh: 如果代理分数在连续三次尝试中仍低于阈值，我们保留尝试样本中得分最高的图像。

sents.en: This fallback rule preserves a fixed dataset size for every compression ratio and prevents failed generations from changing the number of downstream training images.
sents.zh: 这一回退规则确保每个压缩比下的数据集大小固定，并防止生成失败改变下游训练图像的数量。

paragraphs.en: We report this method as UniDD ∗ to indicate that it is a segmentation-oriented adaptation of UniDD rather than the official implementation. Compared with the vanilla SD3.5 baseline, UniDD ∗ uses mask-conditioned generation and task-specific proxy filtering. Compared with S 2 -RL, it does not fine-tune the diffusion policy with sample-set rewards, but instead relies on iterative proxy-guided sampling from the pretrained FreestyleNet generator.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将该方法报告为 UniDD ∗，以表明它是 UniDD 面向分割任务的适配版本，而非官方实现。 与原始 SD3.5 基线相比，UniDD ∗ 使用了掩码条件生成和任务特定的代理过滤。 与 S 2 -RL 相比，它不使用样本集奖励对扩散策略进行微调，而是依赖从预训练的 FreestyleNet 生成器进行的迭代式代理引导采样。

sents.en: We report this method as UniDD ∗ to indicate that it is a segmentation-oriented adaptation of UniDD rather than the official implementation.
sents.zh: 我们将该方法报告为 UniDD ∗，以表明它是 UniDD 面向分割任务的适配版本，而非官方实现。

sents.en: Compared with the vanilla SD3.5 baseline, UniDD ∗ uses mask-conditioned generation and task-specific proxy filtering.
sents.zh: 与原始 SD3.5 基线相比，UniDD ∗ 使用了掩码条件生成和任务特定的代理过滤。

sents.en: Compared with S 2 -RL, it does not fine-tune the diffusion policy with sample-set rewards, but instead relies on iterative proxy-guided sampling from the pretrained FreestyleNet generator.
sents.zh: 与 S 2 -RL 相比，它不使用样本集奖励对扩散策略进行微调，而是依赖从预训练的 FreestyleNet 生成器进行的迭代式代理引导采样。

paragraphs.en: We use the zero-KL setting adopted in the GRPO-Guard [ 38 ] training configuration, where the KL loss is not applied. GRPO-Guard stabilizes GRPO-style optimization for diffusion/flow models through regulated clipping, implemented by ratio normalization and gradient reweighting across denoising timesteps. These operations restore more balanced importance-ratio distributions and reduce timestep-wise gradient imbalance during policy optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用 GRPO-Guard [38] 训练配置中所采用的 zero-KL 设置，即不应用 KL 损失。 GRPO-Guard 通过受控裁剪为扩散/流模型稳定了 GRPO 风格的优化，该裁剪通过比率归一化以及在去噪时间步上的梯度重加权来实现。 这些操作恢复了更均衡的重要性比率分布，并减少了策略优化过程中逐时间步的梯度不平衡。

paragraphs.en: We describe the reward computation process used during GRPO fine-tuning. In each training iteration, we sample 16 text prompts from the prompt pool. For each prompt, the rollout policy generates a group of 8 trajectories for ADE20K or 16 for COCO, each producing one candidate image. Rewards are computed on the final images, while the policy update uses the stored denoising trajectories to evaluate the clipped per-step importance-ratio objective described in Appendix A.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们描述在GRPO微调过程中使用的奖励计算流程。 在每次训练迭代中，我们从提示池中采样16个文本提示。 对于每个提示，rollout策略会生成一组8条轨迹（ADE20K）或16条轨迹（COCO），每条轨迹产出一幅候选图像。 奖励在最终图像上计算，而策略更新则利用存储的去噪轨迹来评估附录A.1中描述的带裁剪的逐步重要性比率目标。

sents.en: We describe the reward computation process used during GRPO fine-tuning.
sents.zh: 我们描述在GRPO微调过程中使用的奖励计算流程。

sents.en: In each training iteration, we sample 16 text prompts from the prompt pool.
sents.zh: 在每次训练迭代中，我们从提示池中采样16个文本提示。

sents.en: For each prompt, the rollout policy generates a group of 8 trajectories for ADE20K or 16 for COCO, each producing one candidate image.
sents.zh: 对于每个提示，rollout策略会生成一组8条轨迹（ADE20K）或16条轨迹（COCO），每条轨迹产出一幅候选图像。

sents.en: Rewards are computed on the final images, while the policy update uses the stored denoising trajectories to evaluate the clipped per-step importance-ratio objective described in Appendix A.1 .
sents.zh: 奖励在最终图像上计算，而策略更新则利用存储的去噪轨迹来评估附录A.1中描述的带裁剪的逐步重要性比率目标。

paragraphs.en: For each generated image, we compute the sample-level reward terms, including semantic alignment and intra-class feature diversity. The semantic alignment reward evaluates whether the generated image is consistent with the target semantic content specified by the prompt. The intra-class diversity reward evaluates whether the image contains discriminative class-level features rather than repetitive or collapsed visual patterns. These two terms are computed independently for each image and provide local supervision for sample quality.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每张生成的图像，我们计算样本级奖励项，包括语义对齐和类内特征多样性。 语义对齐奖励评估生成图像是否与提示词指定的目标语义内容一致。 类内多样性奖励评估图像是否包含有区分性的类级特征，而不是重复或坍缩的视觉模式。 这两项针对每张图像独立计算，为样本质量提供局部监督。

sents.en: For each generated image, we compute the sample-level reward terms, including semantic alignment and intra-class feature diversity.
sents.zh: 对于每张生成的图像，我们计算样本级奖励项，包括语义对齐和类内特征多样性。

sents.en: The semantic alignment reward evaluates whether the generated image is consistent with the target semantic content specified by the prompt.
sents.zh: 语义对齐奖励评估生成图像是否与提示词指定的目标语义内容一致。

sents.en: These two terms are computed independently for each image and provide local supervision for sample quality.
sents.zh: 这两项针对每张图像独立计算，为样本质量提供局部监督。

paragraphs.en: The set-level reward is computed on the same generated batch rather than on a separate reward batch. After extracting semantic features from all generated images in the current iteration, each feature is assigned to its nearest semantic prototype. We then accumulate the prototype-count increment induced by the current mini-batch. The set-level reward is evaluated using both the historical prototype counts and the current batch-level increment, before committing the new counts to the global memory. This batch-aware update prevents reward inflation across iterations rather than within a single batch: samples that match the same prototype within a single iteration receive the same exploration bonus, but historical counts are updated only after the entire batch has been evaluated, so later iterations correctly see the marginal coverage contributed by the previous one.
paragraphs.zh: 集合级奖励是在同一批生成结果上计算的，而不是在单独的奖励批次上计算。 在从当前迭代中所有生成的图像中提取语义特征后，每个特征都被分配到其最近的语义原型。 然后，我们累加由当前小批量引起的原型计数增量。 在将新计数提交到全局记忆之前，集合级奖励使用历史原型计数和当前批次级增量来进行评估。 这种批次感知的更新机制防止的是跨迭代的奖励膨胀，而非单个批次内的膨胀：在同一次迭代中匹配同一原型的样本会获得相同的探索加成，但历史计数只在整个批次评估完毕后才更新，因此后续迭代能够正确看到前一次迭代带来的边际覆盖贡献。

sents.en: The set-level reward is computed on the same generated batch rather than on a separate reward batch.
sents.zh: 集合级奖励是在同一批生成结果上计算的，而不是在单独的奖励批次上计算。

sents.en: After extracting semantic features from all generated images in the current iteration, each feature is assigned to its nearest semantic prototype.
sents.zh: 在从当前迭代中所有生成的图像中提取语义特征后，每个特征都被分配到其最近的语义原型。

sents.en: We then accumulate the prototype-count increment induced by the current mini-batch.
sents.zh: 然后，我们累加由当前小批量引起的原型计数增量。

sents.en: The set-level reward is evaluated using both the historical prototype counts and the current batch-level increment, before committing the new counts to the global memory.
sents.zh: 在将新计数提交到全局记忆之前，集合级奖励使用历史原型计数和当前批次级增量来进行评估。

sents.en: This batch-aware update prevents reward inflation across iterations rather than within a single batch: samples that match the same prototype within a single iteration receive the same exploration bonus, but historical counts are updated only after the entire batch has been evaluated, so later iterations correctly see the marginal coverage contributed by the previous one.
sents.zh: 这种批次感知的更新机制防止的是跨迭代的奖励膨胀，而非单个批次内的膨胀：在同一次迭代中匹配同一原型的样本会获得相同的探索加成，但历史计数只在整个批次评估完毕后才更新，因此后续迭代能够正确看到前一次迭代带来的边际覆盖贡献。

paragraphs.en: After combining the sample-level and set-level rewards, GRPO computes advantages within each same-prompt group. Specifically, the G G rewards belonging to one prompt are normalized within that group, and the resulting advantages are clipped to [ − 5 , 5 ] [-5,5] before use in the surrogate. We do not normalize rewards across all 16 prompts in the iteration. This design ensures that the policy compares alternative generations under the same semantic condition, rather than mixing reward scales across unrelated prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 在合并样本级与集合级奖励之后，GRPO 在每个相同提示词的组内计算优势。 具体而言，属于同一提示词的 G 个奖励会在该组内进行归一化，所得的优势在用于替代目标之前被裁剪到 [-5,5]。 我们不会在迭代中对全部 16 个提示词的奖励进行跨组归一化。 这一设计确保策略在相同的语义条件下比较不同的生成结果，而不是将无关提示词的奖励量纲混在一起。

sents.en: After combining the sample-level and set-level rewards, GRPO computes advantages within each same-prompt group.
sents.zh: 在合并样本级与集合级奖励之后，GRPO 在每个相同提示词的组内计算优势。

sents.en: Specifically, the G G rewards belonging to one prompt are normalized within that group, and the resulting advantages are clipped to [ − 5 , 5 ] [-5,5] before use in the surrogate.
sents.zh: 具体而言，属于同一提示词的 G 个奖励会在该组内进行归一化，所得的优势在用于替代目标之前被裁剪到 [-5,5]。

sents.en: We do not normalize rewards across all 16 prompts in the iteration.
sents.zh: 我们不会在迭代中对全部 16 个提示词的奖励进行跨组归一化。

sents.en: This design ensures that the policy compares alternative generations under the same semantic condition, rather than mixing reward scales across unrelated prompts.
sents.zh: 这一设计确保策略在相同的语义条件下比较不同的生成结果，而不是将无关提示词的奖励量纲混在一起。

paragraphs.en: The sample-level and set-level rewards serve different roles in optimization. The sample-level rewards guide each individual image toward semantic correctness and feature discriminability. The set-level reward tracks prototype visitation during policy training and assigns larger bonuses to under-covered semantic modes. Therefore, the set-level reward does not duplicate the sample-level objectives; instead, it introduces a dataset-level exploration signal that encourages the policy to construct a more balanced and informative synthetic set.
paragraphs.zh: 样本级奖励和集合级奖励在优化中发挥不同的作用。 样本级奖励引导每张图像走向语义正确性和特征可区分性。 集合级奖励在策略训练期间追踪原型的访问情况，并为覆盖不足的语义模式分配更大的奖励。 因此，集合级奖励并不重复样本级目标；相反，它引入了一个数据集级的探索信号，鼓励策略构建一个更加均衡且信息更丰富的合成集合。

paragraphs.en: Approximately matched generative computation. The unadapted SD3.5 best-of- N N control uses the same class-list prompts and generates approximately 200 candidates per prompt. Candidates are screened with the same sample-level and set-level reward functions used in policy training, retaining one image per prompt and 202 images per set. S 2 -RL generates four candidates per prompt after policy adaptation and retains the same dataset size. Best-of- N N uses approximately 50 GPU-hours for generation; S 2 -RL uses approximately 48 for adaptation and 1 for generation. These totals compare generative GPU-hours, without a complete accounting of preprocessing, reward evaluation, pseudo-labeling, or downstream training. Both methods follow the same five-set, five-student-seed evaluation protocol.

paragraphs.en: Generator and Compute Controls. Table 7 (a) compares S 2 -RL with a mask-conditioned UniDD ∗ adaptation using the same SD3.5 backbone. Table 7 (b) compares policy adaptation with best-of- N N sampling under a similar generative budget. paragraphs.en: In this section, we provide extensive qualitative results to demonstrate the visual fidelity and semantic diversity of the synthetic datasets generated by S 2 -RL. We showcase all generated images from both ADE20K and COCO datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们提供了大量的定性结果，以展示由 S 2 -RL 生成的合成数据集的视觉保真度和语义多样性。 我们展示了来自 ADE20K 和 COCO 数据集的所有生成图像。

sents.en: In this section, we provide extensive qualitative results to demonstrate the visual fidelity and semantic diversity of the synthetic datasets generated by S 2 -RL.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们提供了大量的定性结果，以展示由 S 2 -RL 生成的合成数据集的视觉保真度和语义多样性。

sents.en: We showcase all generated images from both ADE20K and COCO datasets.
sents.zh: 我们展示了来自 ADE20K 和 COCO 数据集的所有生成图像。

paragraphs.en: Figures 4 , 5 , and 7 display all synthetic images generated for the ADE20K dataset using the first generation seed. The results highlight our model’s ability to synthesize complex scene layouts, such as cluttered bedrooms and diverse street scenes, strictly following the semantic constraints defined in the prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4、图 5 和图 7 展示了使用第一代随机种子为 ADE20K 数据集生成的所有合成图像。 这些结果突出了我们模型合成复杂场景布局的能力，例如杂乱的卧室和多样的街景，并且严格遵循提示词中定义的语义约束。

sents.en: Figures 4 , 5 , and 7 display all synthetic images generated for the ADE20K dataset using the first generation seed.
sents.zh: 图 4、图 5 和图 7 展示了使用第一代随机种子为 ADE20K 数据集生成的所有合成图像。

sents.en: The results highlight our model’s ability to synthesize complex scene layouts, such as cluttered bedrooms and diverse street scenes, strictly following the semantic constraints defined in the prompts.
sents.zh: 这些结果突出了我们模型合成复杂场景布局的能力，例如杂乱的卧室和多样的街景，并且严格遵循提示词中定义的语义约束。

paragraphs.en: Figures 8 , 9 , and 12 present the generation results on the COCO dataset using the first generation seed. Compared to ADE20K, COCO contains more object-centric scenes with varied backgrounds. S 2 -RL effectively handles these variations, producing high-fidelity objects with diverse textures and lighting conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 图8、图9和图12展示了使用第一代生成种子在COCO数据集上的生成结果。 与ADE20K相比，COCO包含更多以物体为中心且背景多样的场景。 S²-RL有效应对这些变化，生成出具有多样纹理和光照条件的高保真物体。

sents.en: Figures 8 , 9 , and 12 present the generation results on the COCO dataset using the first generation seed.
sents.zh: 图8、图9和图12展示了使用第一代生成种子在COCO数据集上的生成结果。

sents.en: Compared to ADE20K, COCO contains more object-centric scenes with varied backgrounds.
sents.zh: 与ADE20K相比，COCO包含更多以物体为中心且背景多样的场景。

sents.en: S 2 -RL effectively handles these variations, producing high-fidelity objects with diverse textures and lighting conditions.
sents.zh: S²-RL有效应对这些变化，生成出具有多样纹理和光照条件的高保真物体。

paragraphs.en: All experiments in this section use ADE20K at the 1.0% budget. The coreset, reward-weight, group-size, prototype, and evaluator ablations use UPerNet with a ResNet-50 backbone; independent-policy evaluation uses SegFormer-B5. We distinguish variation across policy training runs from variation across downstream student seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 本节所有实验均在 1.0% 预算下使用 ADE20K。 核心集、奖励权重、组大小、原型和评估器的消融实验使用带 ResNet-50 骨干网络的 UPerNet；独立策略评估使用 SegFormer-B5。 我们将不同策略训练运行之间的差异与不同下游学生种子之间的差异区分开来。

sents.en: All experiments in this section use ADE20K at the 1.0% budget.
sents.zh: 本节所有实验均在 1.0% 预算下使用 ADE20K。

sents.en: The coreset, reward-weight, group-size, prototype, and evaluator ablations use UPerNet with a ResNet-50 backbone; independent-policy evaluation uses SegFormer-B5.
sents.zh: 核心集、奖励权重、组大小、原型和评估器的消融实验使用带 ResNet-50 骨干网络的 UPerNet；独立策略评估使用 SegFormer-B5。

sents.en: We distinguish variation across policy training runs from variation across downstream student seeds.
sents.zh: 我们将不同策略训练运行之间的差异与不同下游学生种子之间的差异区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We further study the influence of feature extractors in coreset selection. The standard K-Center and Herding baselines follow their conventional setup and use ResNet-50 features for selection. Since S 2 -RL uses DINOv3 features inside the set-level reward computation, we additionally rerun K-Center and Herding with DINOv3 features while keeping the downstream training protocol unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步研究特征提取器在核心集选择中的影响。 标准 K-Center 与 Herding 基线遵循其常规设置，使用 ResNet-50 特征进行选择。 由于 S 2 -RL 在集合级别奖励计算中使用 DINOv3 特征，我们还使用 DINOv3 特征重新运行了 K-Center 和 Herding，同时保持下游训练协议不变。

sents.en: We further study the influence of feature extractors in coreset selection.
sents.zh: 我们进一步研究特征提取器在核心集选择中的影响。

sents.en: The standard K-Center and Herding baselines follow their conventional setup and use ResNet-50 features for selection.
sents.zh: 标准 K-Center 与 Herding 基线遵循其常规设置，使用 ResNet-50 特征进行选择。

sents.en: Since S 2 -RL uses DINOv3 features inside the set-level reward computation, we additionally rerun K-Center and Herding with DINOv3 features while keeping the downstream training protocol unchanged.
sents.zh: 由于 S 2 -RL 在集合级别奖励计算中使用 DINOv3 特征，我们还使用 DINOv3 特征重新运行了 K-Center 和 Herding，同时保持下游训练协议不变。

paragraphs.en: This analysis is conducted on ADE20K at the 1.0% budget under the canonical UPerNet + ResNet-50 downstream evaluation protocol. The purpose of this controlled experiment is to isolate the effect of the feature extractor used for subset selection. We independently train the same downstream segmentation architecture on each selected subset.
paragraphs.zh: 该分析在 ADE20K 数据集上、在 1.0% 预算下、按照标准的 UPerNet + ResNet-50 下游评估协议进行。 这项对照实验的目的是隔离用于子集选择的特征提取器所带来的影响。 我们在每个选定的子集上独立训练相同的下游分割架构。

sents.en: This analysis is conducted on ADE20K at the 1.0% budget under the canonical UPerNet + ResNet-50 downstream evaluation protocol.
sents.zh: 该分析在 ADE20K 数据集上、在 1.0% 预算下、按照标准的 UPerNet + ResNet-50 下游评估协议进行。

sents.en: The purpose of this controlled experiment is to isolate the effect of the feature extractor used for subset selection.
sents.zh: 这项对照实验的目的是隔离用于子集选择的特征提取器所带来的影响。

sents.en: We independently train the same downstream segmentation architecture on each selected subset.
sents.zh: 我们在每个选定的子集上独立训练相同的下游分割架构。

paragraphs.en: Replacing ResNet-50 with DINOv3 improves the two coreset baselines. K-Center improves from 14.35 to 14.98 mIoU, and Herding improves from 11.88 to 12.66 mIoU. This shows that stronger representation features can improve subset selection quality.
paragraphs.zh: 将 ResNet-50 替换为 DINOv3 可以提升两个核心集基线。 K-Center 从 14.35 提升到 14.98 mIoU，Herding 从 11.88 提升到 12.66 mIoU。 这表明更强的表示特征可以提高子集选择的质量。

sents.en: Replacing ResNet-50 with DINOv3 improves the two coreset baselines.
sents.zh: 将 ResNet-50 替换为 DINOv3 可以提升两个核心集基线。

sents.en: K-Center improves from 14.35 to 14.98 mIoU, and Herding improves from 11.88 to 12.66 mIoU.
sents.zh: K-Center 从 14.35 提升到 14.98 mIoU，Herding 从 11.88 提升到 12.66 mIoU。

sents.en: This shows that stronger representation features can improve subset selection quality.
sents.zh: 这表明更强的表示特征可以提高子集选择的质量。

paragraphs.en: S 2 -RL still achieves the best performance under the same downstream evaluation protocol. This indicates that the improvement of S 2 -RL is not solely explained by the use of DINOv3 features. Instead, feature-based selection and reward-driven scene construction play different roles: DINOv3 improves the representation space for selecting existing samples, while S 2 -RL uses the same type of semantic representation to guide generative exploration and construct new high-density training samples.
paragraphs.zh: 在相同的下游评估协议下，S 2 -RL 仍然取得了最佳性能。 这表明 S 2 -RL 的提升并非仅仅源于 DINOv3 特征的使用。 相反，基于特征的选择与奖励驱动的场景构建扮演着不同的角色：DINOv3 改进了用于选择已有样本的表示空间，而 S 2 -RL 则利用同类语义表示来引导生成式探索并构建新的高密度训练样本。

sents.en: S 2 -RL still achieves the best performance under the same downstream evaluation protocol.
sents.zh: 在相同的下游评估协议下，S 2 -RL 仍然取得了最佳性能。

sents.en: This indicates that the improvement of S 2 -RL is not solely explained by the use of DINOv3 features.
sents.zh: 这表明 S 2 -RL 的提升并非仅仅源于 DINOv3 特征的使用。

sents.en: Instead, feature-based selection and reward-driven scene construction play different roles: DINOv3 improves the representation space for selecting existing samples, while S 2 -RL uses the same type of semantic representation to guide generative exploration and construct new high-density training samples.
sents.zh: 相反，基于特征的选择与奖励驱动的场景构建扮演着不同的角色：DINOv3 改进了用于选择已有样本的表示空间，而 S 2 -RL 则利用同类语义表示来引导生成式探索并构建新的高密度训练样本。

paragraphs.en: The total reward in Eq. 8 is a weighted sum of alignment ( γ a \gamma_{a} ), diversity ( γ d \gamma_{d} ), and scarcity ( γ s \gamma_{s} ) terms. We investigate the sensitivity of the downstream performance to variations in these weights.
paragraphs.zh: 式 8 中的总奖励是对齐项（ γ a \gamma_{a} ）、多样性项（ γ d \gamma_{d} ）和稀缺性项（ γ s \gamma_{s} ）的加权和。 我们研究了下游性能对这些权重变化的敏感性。

sents.en: The total reward in Eq. 8 is a weighted sum of alignment ( γ a \gamma_{a} ), diversity ( γ d \gamma_{d} ), and scarcity ( γ s \gamma_{s} ) terms.
sents.zh: 式 8 中的总奖励是对齐项（ γ a \gamma_{a} ）、多样性项（ γ d \gamma_{d} ）和稀缺性项（ γ s \gamma_{s} ）的加权和。

sents.en: We investigate the sensitivity of the downstream performance to variations in these weights.
sents.zh: 我们研究了下游性能对这些权重变化的敏感性。

paragraphs.en: Analysis. As shown in Table 9 , S 2 -RL demonstrates remarkable robustness to hyperparameter variations. While the optimal configuration ( γ d = 5.0 , γ s = 3.0 \gamma_{d}=5.0,\gamma_{s}=3.0 ) yields a peak mIoU of 15.43%, deviating from these values results in only marginal fluctuations. Notably, even when the diversity weight is drastically increased to 10.0 or the scarcity weight is adjusted, the model consistently maintains a mIoU above 14.66%, with a maximum performance drop of less than 0.8%. This stability indicates that our framework relies on the intrinsic synergy of the proposed reward components rather than precise hyperparameter tuning, ensuring reliable performance across a broad range of settings.
paragraphs.zh: 分析。 如表 9 所示，S²-RL 对超参数变化表现出显著的鲁棒性。 尽管最优配置（γ_d = 5.0，γ_s = 3.0）可带来 15.43% 的峰值 mIoU，但偏离这些数值仅会导致微小的波动。 值得注意的是，即使将多样性权重大幅增加至 10.0 或对稀缺性权重进行调整，模型始终能保持 mIoU 高于 14.66%，最大性能下降小于 0.8%。 这种稳定性表明，我们的框架依赖于所提出的奖励组件之间的内在协同作用，而非精确的超参数调优，从而确保在广泛的设置范围内具有可靠的性能。

sents.en: Analysis.
sents.zh: 分析。

sents.en: As shown in Table 9 , S 2 -RL demonstrates remarkable robustness to hyperparameter variations.
sents.zh: 如表 9 所示，S²-RL 对超参数变化表现出显著的鲁棒性。

sents.en: While the optimal configuration ( γ d = 5.0 , γ s = 3.0 \gamma_{d}=5.0,\gamma_{s}=3.0 ) yields a peak mIoU of 15.43%, deviating from these values results in only marginal fluctuations.
sents.zh: 尽管最优配置（γ_d = 5.0，γ_s = 3.0）可带来 15.43% 的峰值 mIoU，但偏离这些数值仅会导致微小的波动。

sents.en: Notably, even when the diversity weight is drastically increased to 10.0 or the scarcity weight is adjusted, the model consistently maintains a mIoU above 14.66%, with a maximum performance drop of less than 0.8%.
sents.zh: 值得注意的是，即使将多样性权重大幅增加至 10.0 或对稀缺性权重进行调整，模型始终能保持 mIoU 高于 14.66%，最大性能下降小于 0.8%。

sents.en: This stability indicates that our framework relies on the intrinsic synergy of the proposed reward components rather than precise hyperparameter tuning, ensuring reliable performance across a broad range of settings.
sents.zh: 这种稳定性表明，我们的框架依赖于所提出的奖励组件之间的内在协同作用，而非精确的超参数调优，从而确保在广泛的设置范围内具有可靠的性能。

paragraphs.en: The group size G G in GRPO determines the accuracy of the baseline estimation for variance reduction. We evaluate the model performance with G ∈ { 4 , 8 , 16 } G\in\{4,8,16\} .
paragraphs.zh: GRPO 中的组大小 G 决定了用于方差缩减的基线估计的准确性。 我们使用 G ∈ {4, 8, 16} 来评估模型性能。

sents.en: The group size G G in GRPO determines the accuracy of the baseline estimation for variance reduction.
sents.zh: GRPO 中的组大小 G 决定了用于方差缩减的基线估计的准确性。

sents.zh: 我们使用 G ∈ {4, 8, 16} 来评估模型性能。

paragraphs.en: Analysis. As shown in Table 10 , increasing G G stabilizes the gradient estimate, leading to faster convergence and higher final mIoU. However, the performance saturates around G = 8 G=8 , after which the computational overhead outweighs the marginal gains. We choose G = 8 G=8 for ADE20K; the COCO configuration uses G = 16 G=16 .
paragraphs.zh: 分析。 如表10所示，增大 G G 能使梯度估计更加稳定，从而带来更快的收敛速度和更高的最终 mIoU。 然而，性能在 G = 8 G=8 附近趋于饱和，此后计算开销超过了边际收益。 我们在 ADE20K 上选择 G = 8 G=8；COCO 的配置则使用 G = 16 G=16。

sents.zh: 分析。

sents.en: As shown in Table 10 , increasing G G stabilizes the gradient estimate, leading to faster convergence and higher final mIoU.

sents.zh: 我们在 ADE20K 上选择 G = 8 G=8；COCO 的配置则使用 G = 16 G=16。

paragraphs.en: Independent policy runs. We independently train three S 2 -RL policies on ADE20K and evaluate their 1.0% constructed sets with SegFormer-B5. After averaging downstream student-seed results within each policy, the mean and standard deviation across policies are 25.18 ± 0.30 25.18\pm 0.30 mIoU and 35.90 ± 0.77 35.90\pm 0.77 mAcc. This measures policy-training variation alongside the variation across constructed sets and student seeds reported in the main comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 独立的策略运行。 我们在 ADE20K 上独立训练三个 S 2 -RL 策略，并使用 SegFormer-B5 在其 1.0% 构建集上进行评估。 在对每个策略内的下游学生随机种子结果取平均后，跨策略的均值和标准差为 25.18 ± 0.30 25.18\pm 0.30 mIoU 和 35.90 ± 0.77 35.90\pm 0.77 mAcc。 这衡量了策略训练的变异性，以及主对比中报告的跨构建集和学生随机种子的变异性。

paragraphs.en: We study the effect of the number of semantic prototypes, or semantic arms, used in the set-level reward. The main experiments use K = 50 K=50 prototypes for each class. We additionally evaluate K = 25 K=25 and K = 100 K=100 on ADE20K at the 1.0% budget.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了集合级奖励中使用的语义原型（即语义臂）数量的影响。 主要实验对每个类别使用 K = 50 K=50 个原型。 我们还在 1.0% 预算下于 ADE20K 上额外评估了 K = 25 K=25 和 K = 100 K=100。

paragraphs.en: The results show that S 2 -RL is not highly sensitive to moderate changes in K K . All three settings produce similar downstream performance, with a maximum difference of 0.43 mIoU. The default setting K = 50 K=50 achieves the best result. Increasing K K from 50 to 100 does not further improve performance and leads to larger variance, suggesting that overly fine-grained prototype partitioning may make the set-level reward less stable under a small data budget.
paragraphs.zh: 结果表明，S²-RL 对 K 的适度变化并不高度敏感。 三种设置都产生了相似的下游性能，最大差异为 0.43 mIoU。 默认设置 K=50 取得了最佳结果。 将 K 从 50 增加到 100 并未进一步提升性能，反而导致更大的方差，这表明过于细粒度的原型划分可能会使集合级奖励在较小数据预算下变得不太稳定。

paragraphs.en: In the current implementation, the same number of prototypes is used for each class. This simple design provides a uniform semantic-arm structure across categories, while the scarcity term in the set-level reward assigns larger bonuses to under-covered semantic modes during generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在当前实现中，每个类别使用相同数量的原型。 这种简单的设计为各类别提供了统一的语义臂结构，而集合级奖励中的稀缺性项会在生成过程中为覆盖不足的语义模式分配更大的奖励。

paragraphs.en: Prototype construction. At K = 50 K=50 , we compare nearest-observed K-means representatives with randomly selected same-class region features. Each representative is an observed region feature rather than a cluster-center vector. Both variants repeat policy adaptation from the same pretrained initialization, keeping the other reward and training settings fixed. Table 12 reports means and standard deviations over five downstream UPerNet–ResNet-50 seeds. The clustered representatives yield better downstream performance, suggesting that prototype placement complements the choice of bank size.
paragraphs.zh: 原型构建。 在 K = 50 K=50 时，我们将最近邻观测的 K-means 代表与随机选取的同类区域特征进行比较。 每个代表都是一个观测到的区域特征，而非聚类中心向量。 两种变体均从相同的预训练初始状态重复策略适配，并保持其他奖励和训练设置不变。 表 12 报告了五个下游 UPerNet–ResNet-50 随机种子的均值和标准差。 聚类代表带来了更好的下游性能，表明原型放置与记忆库大小的选择是互补的。

paragraphs.en: S 2 -RL uses frozen segmentation models as reward evaluators during diffusion policy optimization. In the main setting, we use an ensemble evaluator to provide a more stable reward signal. We further study how the choice of reward evaluator affects the final distilled set by replacing the ensemble with a single frozen segmentation model.
paragraphs.zh: S 2 -RL 在扩散策略优化过程中使用冻结的分割模型作为奖励评估器。 在主设定中，我们使用集成评估器来提供更稳定的奖励信号。 我们进一步研究奖励评估器的选择如何影响最终的蒸馏集合，方法是将集成替换为单个冻结的分割模型。

sents.en: S 2 -RL uses frozen segmentation models as reward evaluators during diffusion policy optimization.
sents.zh: S 2 -RL 在扩散策略优化过程中使用冻结的分割模型作为奖励评估器。

sents.en: In the main setting, we use an ensemble evaluator to provide a more stable reward signal.
sents.zh: 在主设定中，我们使用集成评估器来提供更稳定的奖励信号。

sents.en: We further study how the choice of reward evaluator affects the final distilled set by replacing the ensemble with a single frozen segmentation model.

paragraphs.en: This analysis keeps the generator prior, RL training protocol, reward formulation, and downstream evaluation protocol fixed. The only changed component is the reward evaluator used during policy optimization. All experiments are conducted on ADE20K at the 1.0% budget using the canonical UPerNet + ResNet-50 downstream student.
paragraphs.zh: 该分析保持生成器先验、强化学习训练协议、奖励设计和下游评估协议不变。 唯一更改的组件是策略优化期间使用的奖励评估器。 所有实验均在 ADE20K 数据集上以 1.0% 的预算使用标准的 UPerNet + ResNet-50 下游学生模型进行。

sents.zh: 该分析保持生成器先验、强化学习训练协议、奖励设计和下游评估协议不变。

sents.zh: 唯一更改的组件是策略优化期间使用的奖励评估器。

sents.zh: 所有实验均在 ADE20K 数据集上以 1.0% 的预算使用标准的 UPerNet + ResNet-50 下游学生模型进行。

paragraphs.en: The results show that S 2 -RL remains effective with different frozen evaluators under the same generator prior. Among the single-evaluator variants, SegFormer-B5 achieves the highest mIoU, followed by DPT-Large and UPerNet. The ensemble evaluator performs best, indicating that aggregating complementary segmentation priors provides a more reliable reward signal for policy optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 结果表明，在相同的生成器先验下，S²-RL 在使用不同的冻结评估器时仍然有效。 在单评估器的各个变体中，SegFormer-B5 取得了最高的 mIoU，其次是 DPT-Large 和 UPerNet。 集成评估器表现最佳，这表明聚合互补的分割先验能够为策略优化提供更可靠的奖励信号。

sents.en: The results show that S 2 -RL remains effective with different frozen evaluators under the same generator prior.
sents.zh: 结果表明，在相同的生成器先验下，S²-RL 在使用不同的冻结评估器时仍然有效。

sents.en: Among the single-evaluator variants, SegFormer-B5 achieves the highest mIoU, followed by DPT-Large and UPerNet.
sents.zh: 在单评估器的各个变体中，SegFormer-B5 取得了最高的 mIoU，其次是 DPT-Large 和 UPerNet。

sents.en: The ensemble evaluator performs best, indicating that aggregating complementary segmentation priors provides a more reliable reward signal for policy optimization.
sents.zh: 集成评估器表现最佳，这表明聚合互补的分割先验能够为策略优化提供更可靠的奖励信号。

paragraphs.en: This controlled study separates evaluator choice from the generator prior. Under the fixed SD3.5 prior, the performance improvement of S 2 -RL does not depend on a single reward-evaluator architecture. Instead, the reward-driven generation process remains effective across multiple segmentation evaluators, while the ensemble setting provides the strongest overall result.
paragraphs.zh: 这项对照研究将评估器的选择与生成器先验分离开来。 在固定的 SD3.5 先验下，S 2 -RL 的性能提升并不依赖于单一的奖励-评估器架构。 相反，奖励驱动的生成过程在多个分割评估器上均保持有效，而集成设置则提供了最强的整体结果。

sents.zh: 这项对照研究将评估器的选择与生成器先验分离开来。
