sents.en: Instead, the reward-driven generation process remains effective across multiple segmentation evaluators, while the ensemble setting provides the strongest overall result.
sents.zh: 相反，奖励驱动的生成过程在多个分割评估器上均保持有效，而集成设置则提供了最强的整体结果。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate five stored constructed sets per method at ADE20K 1.0% (202 images per set) and COCO 2.5‰ (295 images per set). A frozen OneFormer-Swin-L [ 18 ] annotates both the constructed images and the official held-out validation reference (2,000 ADE20K and 5,000 COCO images). All four methods, including real-image Uniform selection, use this same annotation source. OneFormer was unused by the original reward, candidate-selection, pseudo-labeling, and student-training pipelines for these sets. This diagnostic is therefore independent of the reward evaluator, although it still relies on pretrained dataset priors.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ADE20K 1.0%（每组 202 张图像）和 COCO 2.5‰（每组 295 张图像）上评估每种方法存储的五个构建集合。 冻结的 OneFormer-Swin-L [18] 对构建图像和官方保留的验证参考集（2,000 张 ADE20K 图像和 5,000 张 COCO 图像）进行标注。 包括真实图像均匀选择在内的所有四种方法都使用同一标注来源。 对于这些集合，原始的奖励、候选选择、伪标签和学生训练流程均未使用 OneFormer。 因此这一诊断独立于奖励评估器，但仍依赖于预训练数据集先验。

paragraphs.en: For semantic appearance, we mask-pool ImageNet-1K V2 ResNet-50 layer-4 features extracted at 448 × 448 448\times 448 resolution; this feature extractor is also unused by the reward. We discard class regions smaller than 0.1% of image area and repeat the analysis at 0.2%. The OneFormer checkpoint revisions are fixed to 4a5bac8e64f82681a12db2e151a4c2f4ce6092b2 (ADE20K) and 3a263017ca5c75adbea145f25f81b118243d4394 (COCO).
paragraphs.zh: 对于语义外观，我们对在 448 × 448 448\times 448 分辨率下提取的 ImageNet-1K V2 ResNet-50 第 4 层特征进行掩码池化；该特征提取器同样不被奖励所使用。 我们舍弃面积小于图像面积 0.1% 的类别区域，并在 0.2% 的阈值下重复该分析。 OneFormer 的检查点版本固定为 4a5bac8e64f82681a12db2e151a4c2f4ce6092b2（ADE20K）和 3a263017ca5c75adbea145f25f81b118243d4394（COCO）。

paragraphs.en: Local-support coverage and precision (C/P). For a held-out descriptor, its self-excluded real 5-nearest-neighbor distance defines a fixed support radius. Coverage is the fraction of held-out descriptors with a constructed descriptor inside their support ball; precision is the fraction of constructed descriptors supported by the union of these fixed real-reference balls. Feature C/P applies this rule to mask-pooled ResNet features, and occupancy C/P to normalized 4 × 4 4\times 4 class-occupancy descriptors. Both are macro-averaged over reference-eligible classes. These are local-support diagnostics, distinct from standard generative precision/recall.
paragraphs.zh: 局部支持覆盖率与精确率（C/P）。 对于一个留出描述子，其排除自身的真实 5 最近邻距离定义了一个固定的支持半径。 覆盖率是支持球内包含至少一个构造描述子的留出描述子的比例；精确率是被这些固定真实参考球的并集所支持的构造描述子的比例。 特征 C/P 将该规则应用于掩码池化的 ResNet 特征，占据率 C/P 则应用于归一化的 4 × 4 4\times 4 类别占据率描述子。 两者均在有资格作为参考的类别上进行宏平均。 这些是局部支持诊断指标，不同于标准的生成式精确率/召回率。

sents.en: Local-support coverage and precision (C/P).
sents.zh: 局部支持覆盖率与精确率（C/P）。

sents.en: For a held-out descriptor, its self-excluded real 5-nearest-neighbor distance defines a fixed support radius.
sents.zh: 对于一个留出描述子，其排除自身的真实 5 最近邻距离定义了一个固定的支持半径。

sents.en: Coverage is the fraction of held-out descriptors with a constructed descriptor inside their support ball; precision is the fraction of constructed descriptors supported by the union of these fixed real-reference balls.
sents.zh: 覆盖率是支持球内包含至少一个构造描述子的留出描述子的比例；精确率是被这些固定真实参考球的并集所支持的构造描述子的比例。

sents.en: Feature C/P applies this rule to mask-pooled ResNet features, and occupancy C/P to normalized 4 × 4 4\times 4 class-occupancy descriptors.
sents.zh: 特征 C/P 将该规则应用于掩码池化的 ResNet 特征，占据率 C/P 则应用于归一化的 4 × 4 4\times 4 类别占据率描述子。

sents.en: Both are macro-averaged over reference-eligible classes.
sents.zh: 两者均在有资格作为参考的类别上进行宏平均。

sents.en: These are local-support diagnostics, distinct from standard generative precision/recall.
sents.zh: 这些是局部支持诊断指标，不同于标准的生成式精确率/召回率。

paragraphs.en: Pair recall/precision and geometry C/P. Pair recall and precision compare the unique category pairs co-occurring within images. For each category pair, geometry uses one descriptor per image from the two class-union masks: horizontal and vertical centroid displacement, log area ratio, and centroid distance normalized by the image diagonal. Geometry C/P applies the fixed-reference support rule separately to pairs with at least ten held-out observations and macro-averages over eligible pairs. These descriptors measure pairwise spatial support, not object boundaries, higher-order scene graphs, or full topology. We also report class-conditional Vendi [ 12 ] on the pooled ResNet features.
paragraphs.zh: 配对召回率/精确率与几何 C/P。 配对召回率和精确率比较图像内共同出现的唯一类别配对。 对于每个类别配对，几何指标从两个类别并集掩码中每幅图像提取一个描述符：水平和垂直质心位移、对数面积比，以及用图像对角线归一化的质心距离。 几何 C/P 对至少有十个留出观测的配对分别应用固定参考支持规则，并对符合条件的配对进行宏平均。 这些描述符衡量的是成对的空间支持关系，而非物体边界、高阶场景图或完整拓扑结构。 我们还在池化的 ResNet 特征上报告了类条件 Vendi [ 12 ]。

sents.en: Pair recall/precision and geometry C/P.
sents.zh: 配对召回率/精确率与几何 C/P。

sents.en: Pair recall and precision compare the unique category pairs co-occurring within images.
sents.zh: 配对召回率和精确率比较图像内共同出现的唯一类别配对。

sents.en: For each category pair, geometry uses one descriptor per image from the two class-union masks: horizontal and vertical centroid displacement, log area ratio, and centroid distance normalized by the image diagonal.
sents.zh: 对于每个类别配对，几何指标从两个类别并集掩码中每幅图像提取一个描述符：水平和垂直质心位移、对数面积比，以及用图像对角线归一化的质心距离。

sents.en: Geometry C/P applies the fixed-reference support rule separately to pairs with at least ten held-out observations and macro-averages over eligible pairs.
sents.zh: 几何 C/P 对至少有十个留出观测的配对分别应用固定参考支持规则，并对符合条件的配对进行宏平均。

sents.en: These descriptors measure pairwise spatial support, not object boundaries, higher-order scene graphs, or full topology.
sents.zh: 这些描述符衡量的是成对的空间支持关系，而非物体边界、高阶场景图或完整拓扑结构。

sents.en: We also report class-conditional Vendi [ 12 ] on the pooled ResNet features.
sents.zh: 我们还在池化的 ResNet 特征上报告了类条件 Vendi [ 12 ]。

paragraphs.en: Statistical scope. Tables 14 and 15 give means and sample standard deviations across five stored sets. A content-hash check found no constructed/reference or cross-method image overlap, but images can be reused across sets of the same method. The reported variation is descriptive set-level variation, not independent-policy uncertainty or a significance test.
paragraphs.zh: 统计范围。 表14和表15给出了五个存储集合上的均值和样本标准差。 内容哈希检查未发现构造集/参考集之间或跨方法的图像重叠，但图像可在同一方法的不同集合之间重复使用。 所报告的变异是描述性的集合层面变异，并非独立策略的不确定性或显著性检验。

paragraphs.en: S 2 -RL has the highest category-pair recall and pair-macro geometry coverage and precision on both datasets. This broader pair coverage comes with lower pair precision. Uniform has the strongest generic feature coverage and slightly higher COCO occupancy coverage ( .304 .304 versus .301 .301 ). Vendi is mixed: S 2 -RL is slightly below SD3.5 on ADE20K and slightly above it on COCO, while remaining below Uniform and UniDD ∗ on both. These results support broader measured category-pair and relative-geometry support rather than universal diversity improvement.
paragraphs.zh: S 2 -RL 在两个数据集上均具有最高的类别对召回率和成对宏几何覆盖率与精确率。 这种更广的成对覆盖伴随着较低的成对精确率。 Uniform 具有最强的通用特征覆盖率，并且 COCO 占用覆盖率略高（.304 .304 对比 .301 .301）。 Vendi 的结果则好坏参半：S 2 -RL 在 ADE20K 上略低于 SD3.5，在 COCO 上略高于 SD3.5，但在两者上均低于 Uniform 和 UniDD ∗。 这些结果支持的是更广泛的实测类别对和相对几何支持，而非普遍的多样性提升。

paragraphs.en: Threshold and aggregation sensitivity. Table 16 combines the stricter 0.2% area cutoff with alternative precision aggregations. The ordering in pair recall and pair-macro geometry C/P persists at the stricter cutoff. Micro precision counts every constructed-set observation, including unsupported classes or pairs; real-frequency-weighted geometry precision weights eligible pairs by held-out occurrence frequency. Geometry precision favors S 2 -RL under pair-macro and real-frequency weighting, while micro-precision results are mixed.
paragraphs.zh: 阈值与聚合敏感性。 表16将更严格的0.2%面积截断值与备选的精确率聚合方式相结合。 在更严格的截断值下，成对召回率与成对宏几何C/P的排序保持不变。 微观精确率统计每一个构造集观测，包括不受支持的四足或成对类别；而真实频率加权的几何精确率按留出集出现频率对合格对进行加权。 在成对宏加权与真实频率加权下，几何精确率更倾向于S 2-RL，而微观精确率的结果则好坏参半。

paragraphs.en: Complementary image-level diagnostics. Table 17 reports FID [ 16 ] , KID [ 1 ] , and PRDC [ 25 ] from InceptionV3 pool-3 features. FID uses full-training-set reference statistics; KID and PRDC use the held-out reference, with 50 KID subsets of size 100 and PRDC k = 5 k=5 . Matched LPIPS [ 46 ] uses AlexNet (v0.1) on up to 100 disjoint image pairs with mask class-set Jaccard similarity at least 0.3, using the original teacher masks for synthetic images and ground-truth masks for Uniform. Results are means and sample standard deviations across the same five stored sets. These metrics do not consistently track segmentation utility: relative to unadapted SD3.5, S 2 -RL has worse ADE20K FID/KID, modestly better COCO distribution scores, and lower matched LPIPS on both datasets. The semantic/layout gains therefore coexist with mixed appearance-space results.
paragraphs.zh: 互补的图像级诊断。 表 17 报告了基于 InceptionV3 pool-3 特征计算的 FID [16]、KID [1] 和 PRDC [25]。 FID 使用完整训练集的参考统计量；KID 和 PRDC 使用留出的参考集，其中 KID 使用 50 个大小为 100 的子集，PRDC 的 k = 5 k=5。 匹配 LPIPS [46] 使用 AlexNet（v0.1），在最多 100 对互不重叠且掩码类别集合 Jaccard 相似度至少为 0.3 的图像对上计算，合成图像使用原始教师掩码，Uniform 使用真值掩码。 结果为相同五个存储集合上的均值和样本标准差。 这些指标与分割实用性并不一致对应：相对于未适配的 SD3.5，S 2 -RL 的 ADE20K FID/KID 更差，COCO 分布分数略好，且在两个数据集上的匹配 LPIPS 都更低。 因此，语义/布局上的提升与混合的外观空间结果并存。

paragraphs.en: While S 2 -RL establishes a new state-of-the-art for semantic segmentation dataset distillation, we identify several limitations inherent to the current framework and outline promising directions for future research.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 S²-RL 为语义分割数据集蒸馏树立了新的最先进水平，但我们指出了当前框架固有的若干局限性，并概述了未来研究的有前景方向。

paragraphs.en: Dataset Construction Cost. S 2 -RL incurs an upfront policy-adaptation cost of approximately 48 GPU-hours, followed by multi-step diffusion sampling. Selection-based methods are substantially cheaper to construct. Although policy optimization avoids differentiating through dense student-training updates, the intended use is offline extreme compression with repeated reuse of a constructed set; the measured generative budget does not establish an end-to-end lifecycle speedup.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集构建成本。 S 2 -RL 会产生约 48 GPU 小时的前置策略适配成本，随后还需要进行多步扩散采样。 基于选择的方法构建成本要低得多。 尽管策略优化避免了对密集的学生训练更新进行微分，但其预期用途是离线极端压缩，并对构建的集合进行重复复用；因此所测得的生成预算并不能确立端到端的生命周期加速。

sents.en: Dataset Construction Cost.
sents.zh: 数据集构建成本。

sents.en: S 2 -RL incurs an upfront policy-adaptation cost of approximately 48 GPU-hours, followed by multi-step diffusion sampling.
sents.zh: S 2 -RL 会产生约 48 GPU 小时的前置策略适配成本，随后还需要进行多步扩散采样。

paragraphs.en: Dependency on pretrained Priors. Our framework relies on the rich semantic priors encapsulated in the pretrained Stable Diffusion 3.5 and the frozen segmentor reward model. Consequently, the performance of S 2 -RL is bounded by the capabilities of these foundation models. For extremely rare categories not well-represented in the Stable Diffusion training corpus, the policy may struggle to generate high-fidelity textures even with RL fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 对预训练先验的依赖。 我们的框架依赖于预训练的 Stable Diffusion 3.5 和冻结的分割器奖励模型中所蕴含的丰富语义先验。 因此，S 2 -RL 的性能受限于这些基础模型的能力。 对于在 Stable Diffusion 训练语料中代表性不足的极其罕见的类别，即使经过强化学习微调，策略也可能难以生成高保真度的纹理。

sents.en: Dependency on pretrained Priors.
sents.zh: 对预训练先验的依赖。

sents.en: Our framework relies on the rich semantic priors encapsulated in the pretrained Stable Diffusion 3.5 and the frozen segmentor reward model.
sents.zh: 我们的框架依赖于预训练的 Stable Diffusion 3.5 和冻结的分割器奖励模型中所蕴含的丰富语义先验。

sents.en: Consequently, the performance of S 2 -RL is bounded by the capabilities of these foundation models.
sents.zh: 因此，S 2 -RL 的性能受限于这些基础模型的能力。

sents.en: For extremely rare categories not well-represented in the Stable Diffusion training corpus, the policy may struggle to generate high-fidelity textures even with RL fine-tuning.
sents.zh: 对于在 Stable Diffusion 训练语料中代表性不足的极其罕见的类别，即使经过强化学习微调，策略也可能难以生成高保真度的纹理。

paragraphs.en: Pseudo-Label Fidelity. Generated training masks can inherit teacher errors, especially for small or ambiguous regions.
paragraphs.zh: 伪标签保真度。 生成的训练掩码可能继承教师的错误，尤其是在小目标或模糊区域上。

sents.en: Pseudo-Label Fidelity.
sents.zh: 伪标签保真度。

sents.en: Generated training masks can inherit teacher errors, especially for small or ambiguous regions.
sents.zh: 生成的训练掩码可能继承教师的错误，尤其是在小目标或模糊区域上。

paragraphs.en: Reward Proxy Gap. We utilize a frozen segmentor as a proxy to estimate the downstream utility of generated samples. While effective, this is an approximation of the true student learning dynamics. There exists a theoretical gap between maximizing the frozen segmentor’s confidence and minimizing the student’s validation loss. In rare cases, the agent might learn to hack the reward by generating adversarial features that satisfy the frozen segmentor but are less transferable to a student model trained independently on the constructed dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 奖励代理差距。 我们利用一个冻结的分割器作为代理，来估计生成样本的下游效用。 这种方法虽然有效，但只是对学生真实学习动态的一种近似。 最大化冻结分割器的置信度与最小化学生的验证损失之间，在理论上存在差距。 在极少数情况下，智能体可能会学会通过生成对抗性特征来破解奖励——这些特征能满足冻结分割器，但对基于所构建数据集独立训练的学生模型的可迁移性较低。

sents.en: Reward Proxy Gap.
sents.zh: 奖励代理差距。

sents.zh: 我们利用一个冻结的分割器作为代理，来估计生成样本的下游效用。

sents.zh: 在极少数情况下，智能体可能会学会通过生成对抗性特征来破解奖励——这些特征能满足冻结分割器，但对基于所构建数据集独立训练的学生模型的可迁移性较低。

paragraphs.en: Extension to Other Dense Prediction Tasks. The proposed sample-set dual reward paradigm is generic and not limited to semantic segmentation. Future work could extend S 2 -RL to other dense prediction tasks, such as instance segmentation by incorporating box-level alignment rewards and depth estimation by replacing the semantic evaluator with a depth consistency reward.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展到其他密集预测任务。 所提出的样本集双重奖励范式具有通用性，并不局限于语义分割。 未来的工作可以将 S 2 -RL 扩展到其他密集预测任务，例如通过引入框级对齐奖励来处理实例分割，以及通过将语义评估器替换为深度一致性奖励来处理深度估计。

sents.en: Extension to Other Dense Prediction Tasks.
sents.zh: 扩展到其他密集预测任务。

sents.en: The proposed sample-set dual reward paradigm is generic and not limited to semantic segmentation.
sents.zh: 所提出的样本集双重奖励范式具有通用性，并不局限于语义分割。

sents.en: Future work could extend S 2 -RL to other dense prediction tasks, such as instance segmentation by incorporating box-level alignment rewards and depth estimation by replacing the semantic evaluator with a depth consistency reward.
sents.zh: 未来的工作可以将 S 2 -RL 扩展到其他密集预测任务，例如通过引入框级对齐奖励来处理实例分割，以及通过将语义评估器替换为深度一致性奖励来处理深度估计。

paragraphs.en: Student-in-the-Loop Optimization. To bridge the reward proxy gap mentioned above, future iterations could incorporate feedback directly from the student model being trained. Although calculating gradients through the student involves high memory costs (the original bi-level bottleneck), one could employ meta-learning techniques or periodic reward model updates to approximate the student’s needs without full gradient unrolling.
paragraphs.zh: 学生在环优化。 为了弥合上述奖励代理差距，未来的迭代可以直接引入来自被训练学生模型的反馈。 尽管通过学生模型计算梯度涉及较高的内存开销（即原始的双层瓶颈），但可以采用元学习技术或周期性奖励模型更新来近似学生的需求，而无需完整的梯度展开。

sents.en: Student-in-the-Loop Optimization.
sents.zh: 学生在环优化。

sents.en: To bridge the reward proxy gap mentioned above, future iterations could incorporate feedback directly from the student model being trained.
sents.zh: 为了弥合上述奖励代理差距，未来的迭代可以直接引入来自被训练学生模型的反馈。

sents.en: Although calculating gradients through the student involves high memory costs (the original bi-level bottleneck), one could employ meta-learning techniques or periodic reward model updates to approximate the student’s needs without full gradient unrolling.
sents.zh: 尽管通过学生模型计算梯度涉及较高的内存开销（即原始的双层瓶颈），但可以采用元学习技术或周期性奖励模型更新来近似学生的需求，而无需完整的梯度展开。

paragraphs.en: This work studies semantic segmentation dataset distillation under compact data budgets. Its primary positive impact is improving the efficiency of dense prediction research by reducing the number of annotated training samples required for downstream model development. By constructing compact synthetic training sets, S 2 -RL may lower storage, annotation, and iteration costs for semantic segmentation experiments, which can make dense prediction model development more accessible in resource-constrained settings.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究在紧凑数据预算下研究语义分割数据集蒸馏。 其主要积极影响是，通过减少下游模型开发所需的标注训练样本数量，提高密集预测研究的效率。 通过构建紧凑的合成训练集，S 2 -RL 可能降低语义分割实验的存储、标注和迭代成本，从而使密集预测模型开发在资源受限的环境中更易于开展。

sents.en: This work studies semantic segmentation dataset distillation under compact data budgets.
sents.zh: 本研究在紧凑数据预算下研究语义分割数据集蒸馏。

sents.en: Its primary positive impact is improving the efficiency of dense prediction research by reducing the number of annotated training samples required for downstream model development.
sents.zh: 其主要积极影响是，通过减少下游模型开发所需的标注训练样本数量，提高密集预测研究的效率。

sents.en: By constructing compact synthetic training sets, S 2 -RL may lower storage, annotation, and iteration costs for semantic segmentation experiments, which can make dense prediction model development more accessible in resource-constrained settings.
sents.zh: 通过构建紧凑的合成训练集，S 2 -RL 可能降低语义分割实验的存储、标注和迭代成本，从而使密集预测模型开发在资源受限的环境中更易于开展。

paragraphs.en: The method also inherits several limitations and risks from pretrained generative and segmentation models. Since S 2 -RL relies on pretrained text-to-image generators and frozen reward evaluators, the generated samples may reflect biases, artifacts, or category imbalances present in these models or in the original training datasets. If such distilled sets are used without careful validation, downstream models may inherit these biases or perform unevenly across rare or visually ambiguous categories. Therefore, the generated data should be treated as a compact training surrogate for research evaluation rather than as a replacement for carefully curated real annotations in safety-critical applications.
paragraphs.zh: 该方法还继承了预训练生成模型和分割模型中的若干局限性与风险。 由于 S2-RL 依赖于预训练的文本到图像生成器和冻结的奖励评估器，生成的样本可能反映这些模型或原始训练数据集中存在的偏见、伪影或类别不平衡。 如果这些蒸馏数据集在未经仔细验证的情况下被使用，下游模型可能继承这些偏见，或在稀有或视觉上模糊的类别上表现不均衡。 因此，生成的数据应被视为用于研究评估的紧凑训练替代品，而不是在安全关键应用中替代经过精心整理的真实标注。

sents.en: The method also inherits several limitations and risks from pretrained generative and segmentation models.
sents.zh: 该方法还继承了预训练生成模型和分割模型中的若干局限性与风险。

sents.en: Since S 2 -RL relies on pretrained text-to-image generators and frozen reward evaluators, the generated samples may reflect biases, artifacts, or category imbalances present in these models or in the original training datasets.
sents.zh: 由于 S2-RL 依赖于预训练的文本到图像生成器和冻结的奖励评估器，生成的样本可能反映这些模型或原始训练数据集中存在的偏见、伪影或类别不平衡。

sents.en: If such distilled sets are used without careful validation, downstream models may inherit these biases or perform unevenly across rare or visually ambiguous categories.
sents.zh: 如果这些蒸馏数据集在未经仔细验证的情况下被使用，下游模型可能继承这些偏见，或在稀有或视觉上模糊的类别上表现不均衡。

sents.en: Therefore, the generated data should be treated as a compact training surrogate for research evaluation rather than as a replacement for carefully curated real annotations in safety-critical applications.
sents.zh: 因此，生成的数据应被视为用于研究评估的紧凑训练替代品，而不是在安全关键应用中替代经过精心整理的真实标注。

paragraphs.en: Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：摘要和引言中提出的主要论点是否准确反映了论文的贡献和范围？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The abstract and introduction state the main contributions of S 2 -RL, including the reformulation of semantic segmentation dataset distillation as reward-driven diffusion policy optimization and the proposed sample-set dual reward design. The claims are supported by experiments on ADE20K and COCO and are scoped to semantic segmentation dataset distillation under compact data budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：摘要和引言阐述了 S²-RL 的主要贡献，包括将语义分割数据集蒸馏重新表述为奖励驱动的扩散策略优化，以及提出的样本集双重奖励设计。 这些论断由在 ADE20K 和 COCO 上的实验支持，并且其适用范围限定于紧凑数据预算下的语义分割数据集蒸馏。

sents.en: Justification: The abstract and introduction state the main contributions of S 2 -RL, including the reformulation of semantic segmentation dataset distillation as reward-driven diffusion policy optimization and the proposed sample-set dual reward design.
sents.zh: 理由：摘要和引言阐述了 S²-RL 的主要贡献，包括将语义分割数据集蒸馏重新表述为奖励驱动的扩散策略优化，以及提出的样本集双重奖励设计。

sents.en: The claims are supported by experiments on ADE20K and COCO and are scoped to semantic segmentation dataset distillation under compact data budgets.
sents.zh: 这些论断由在 ADE20K 和 COCO 上的实验支持，并且其适用范围限定于紧凑数据预算下的语义分割数据集蒸馏。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the abstract and introduction do not include the claims made in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示摘要和引言中不包含论文中所做出的声明。

paragraphs.en: The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations. A [No] or [N/A] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要和/或引言应清楚陈述论文所作的主张，包括论文中作出的贡献以及重要的假设和局限性。 对此问题回答 [No] 或 [N/A] 将不会被审稿人认可。

sents.en: The abstract and/or introduction should clearly state the claims made, including the contributions made in the paper and important assumptions and limitations.
sents.zh: 摘要和/或引言应清楚陈述论文所作的主张，包括论文中作出的贡献以及重要的假设和局限性。

sents.en: A [No] or [N/A] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers.
sents.zh: 对此问题回答 [No] 或 [N/A] 将不会被审稿人认可。

paragraphs.en: The claims made should match theoretical and experimental results, and reflect how much the results can be expected to generalize to other settings.
paragraphs.zh: 所做出的声明应当与理论和实验结果相符，并反映出这些结果在多大程度上可以预期推广到其他情境。

paragraphs.en: It is fine to include aspirational goals as motivation as long as it is clear that these goals are not attained by the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 可以包含愿景性目标作为动机，只要明确这些目标并未在论文中实现即可。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否讨论了作者所完成工作的局限性？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The main text discusses upfront construction cost and possible pseudo-label errors. The appendix further discusses dependence on pretrained models and the reward proxy gap between frozen evaluator scores and downstream student learning dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：正文讨论了前期构建成本和可能出现的伪标签错误。 附录进一步讨论了对预训练模型的依赖，以及冻结评估器评分与下游学生学习动态之间的奖励代理差距。

sents.en: Justification: The main text discusses upfront construction cost and possible pseudo-label errors.
sents.zh: 理由：正文讨论了前期构建成本和可能出现的伪标签错误。

sents.en: The appendix further discusses dependence on pretrained models and the reward proxy gap between frozen evaluator scores and downstream student learning dynamics.
sents.zh: 附录进一步讨论了对预训练模型的依赖，以及冻结评估器评分与下游学生学习动态之间的奖励代理差距。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper has no limitation while the answer [No] means that the paper has limitations, but those are not discussed in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文没有局限性，而答案 [No] 表示该论文存在局限性，但论文中未对这些局限性进行讨论。

paragraphs.en: The authors are encouraged to create a separate “Limitations” section in their paper.
paragraphs.zh: 鼓励作者在论文中单独创建一个「局限性」章节。

paragraphs.en: The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally). The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be.
paragraphs.zh: 本文应指出所有较强的假设，以及当这些假设被违反时结果的稳健性如何（例如，独立性假设、无噪声设定、模型设定良好、渐近近似仅在局部成立）。 作者应思考这些假设在实践中可能如何被违反，以及由此带来的影响是什么。

sents.en: The paper should point out any strong assumptions and how robust the results are to violations of these assumptions (e.g., independence assumptions, noiseless settings, model well-specification, asymptotic approximations only holding locally).
sents.zh: 本文应指出所有较强的假设，以及当这些假设被违反时结果的稳健性如何（例如，独立性假设、无噪声设定、模型设定良好、渐近近似仅在局部成立）。

sents.en: The authors should reflect on how these assumptions might be violated in practice and what the implications would be.
sents.zh: 作者应思考这些假设在实践中可能如何被违反，以及由此带来的影响是什么。

paragraphs.en: The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs. In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应当反思所提出主张的范围，例如，该方法是否仅在少数数据集上或仅用少数几次运行进行了测试。 总体而言，实证结果往往依赖于隐含的假设，而这些假设应当被明确阐述。

sents.en: The authors should reflect on the scope of the claims made, e.g., if the approach was only tested on a few datasets or with a few runs.
sents.zh: 作者应当反思所提出主张的范围，例如，该方法是否仅在少数数据集上或仅用少数几次运行进行了测试。

sents.en: In general, empirical results often depend on implicit assumptions, which should be articulated.
sents.zh: 总体而言，实证结果往往依赖于隐含的假设，而这些假设应当被明确阐述。

paragraphs.en: The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach. For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting. Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应当反思影响该方法性能的因素。 例如，人脸识别算法在图像分辨率较低或在低光照条件下拍摄的图像上可能表现不佳。 又或者，语音转文本系统可能无法可靠地用于为在线讲座提供隐藏字幕，因为它无法处理技术术语。

sents.en: The authors should reflect on the factors that influence the performance of the approach.
sents.zh: 作者应当反思影响该方法性能的因素。

sents.en: For example, a facial recognition algorithm may perform poorly when image resolution is low or images are taken in low lighting.
sents.zh: 例如，人脸识别算法在图像分辨率较低或在低光照条件下拍摄的图像上可能表现不佳。

sents.en: Or a speech-to-text system might not be used reliably to provide closed captions for online lectures because it fails to handle technical jargon.
sents.zh: 又或者，语音转文本系统可能无法可靠地用于为在线讲座提供隐藏字幕，因为它无法处理技术术语。

paragraphs.en: The authors should discuss the computational efficiency of the proposed algorithms and how they scale with dataset size.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应当讨论所提出算法的计算效率，以及它们如何随数据集规模进行扩展。

paragraphs.en: If applicable, the authors should discuss possible limitations of their approach to address problems of privacy and fairness.
paragraphs.zh: 如有适用，作者应讨论其方法在解决隐私和公平性问题方面可能存在的局限性。

paragraphs.en: While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper. The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community. Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管作者可能担心对局限性的完全坦诚会被审稿人用作拒稿的理由，但更糟糕的结果可能是审稿人发现了论文中并未承认的局限性。 作者应尽其最佳判断，并认识到支持透明度的个人行为在建立维护学界诚信的规范方面发挥着重要作用。 审稿人将受到明确指示，不得因坦诚说明局限性而加以惩罚。

sents.en: While the authors might fear that complete honesty about limitations might be used by reviewers as grounds for rejection, a worse outcome might be that reviewers discover limitations that aren’t acknowledged in the paper.
sents.zh: 尽管作者可能担心对局限性的完全坦诚会被审稿人用作拒稿的理由，但更糟糕的结果可能是审稿人发现了论文中并未承认的局限性。

sents.en: The authors should use their best judgment and recognize that individual actions in favor of transparency play an important role in developing norms that preserve the integrity of the community.
sents.zh: 作者应尽其最佳判断，并认识到支持透明度的个人行为在建立维护学界诚信的规范方面发挥着重要作用。

sents.en: Reviewers will be specifically instructed to not penalize honesty concerning limitations.
sents.zh: 审稿人将受到明确指示，不得因坦诚说明局限性而加以惩罚。

paragraphs.en: Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于每个理论结果，论文是否提供了完整的假设集合以及完整（且正确）的证明？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper presents theoretical propositions as optimization interpretations. The main text states the high-level proposition, and the appendix provides detailed derivations and supporting propositions for GRPO gradient estimation and the sample-set dual reward mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文将理论命题作为优化的解释加以呈现。 正文给出高层次命题，附录则为 GRPO 梯度估计与样本集对偶奖励机制提供详细推导及支持性命题。

sents.en: Justification: The paper presents theoretical propositions as optimization interpretations.
sents.zh: 理由：本文将理论命题作为优化的解释加以呈现。

sents.en: The main text states the high-level proposition, and the appendix provides detailed derivations and supporting propositions for GRPO gradient estimation and the sample-set dual reward mechanism.
sents.zh: 正文给出高层次命题，附录则为 GRPO 梯度估计与样本集对偶奖励机制提供详细推导及支持性命题。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include theoretical results.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含理论结果。

paragraphs.en: All the theorems, formulas, and proofs in the paper should be numbered and cross-referenced.
paragraphs.zh: 论文中的所有定理、公式和证明都应进行编号并交叉引用。

paragraphs.en: All assumptions should be clearly stated or referenced in the statement of any theorems.
paragraphs.zh: 所有假设都应在定理的陈述中明确说明或引用。

paragraphs.en: The proofs can either appear in the main paper or the supplemental material, but if they appear in the supplemental material, the authors are encouraged to provide a short proof sketch to provide intuition.
paragraphs.zh: 证明可以出现在正文中，也可以出现在补充材料中，但如果证明出现在补充材料中，鼓励作者提供简短的证明思路以提供直观理解。

paragraphs.en: Inversely, any informal proof provided in the core of the paper should be complemented by formal proofs provided in appendix or supplemental material.
paragraphs.zh: 反过来，论文正文中提供的任何非形式化证明都应由附录或补充材料中提供的形式化证明加以补充。

paragraphs.en: Theorems and Lemmas that the proof relies upon should be properly referenced.
paragraphs.zh: 证明所依据的定理和引理应当被恰当地引用。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否充分披露了复现论文主要实验结果所需的全部信息，以至于影响到论文的主要论断和/或结论（无论是否提供了代码和数据）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper specifies datasets, compression ratios, baselines, downstream architectures, evaluation metrics, training schedules, reward definitions, and key hyperparameters. Additional implementation details, UniDD ∗ baseline settings, computational resources, and ablation protocols are provided in the appendix.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：论文明确了数据集、压缩率、基线、下游架构、评估指标、训练日程、奖励定义以及关键超参数。 附加的实现细节、UniDD ∗ 基线设置、计算资源以及消融实验方案见附录。

sents.en: Justification: The paper specifies datasets, compression ratios, baselines, downstream architectures, evaluation metrics, training schedules, reward definitions, and key hyperparameters.
sents.zh: 理由：论文明确了数据集、压缩率、基线、下游架构、评估指标、训练日程、奖励定义以及关键超参数。

sents.en: Additional implementation details, UniDD ∗ baseline settings, computational resources, and ablation protocols are provided in the appendix.
sents.zh: 附加的实现细节、UniDD ∗ 基线设置、计算资源以及消融实验方案见附录。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not include experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含实验。

paragraphs.en: If the paper includes experiments, a [No] answer to this question will not be perceived well by the reviewers: Making the paper reproducible is important, regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not.
paragraphs.zh: 如果论文包含实验，审稿人对该问题回答 [No] 的观感不佳：无论是否提供代码和数据，使论文可复现都是很重要的。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is a dataset and/or model, the authors should describe the steps taken to make their results reproducible or verifiable.
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献是数据集和/或模型，作者应描述其为使结果可复现或可验证所采取的步骤。

paragraphs.en: Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways. For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model. In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed.
paragraphs.zh: 根据贡献类型的不同，可以通过多种方式实现可复现性。 例如，如果贡献是一种新架构，那么完整描述该架构可能就足够了；而如果贡献是一个具体的模型及其实证评估，则可能需要让他人能够使用相同的数据集复现该模型，或者提供对该模型的访问。 一般来说，发布代码和数据通常是实现这一目标的一种好方法，但可复现性也可以通过提供如何复现结果的详细说明、提供托管模型的访问方式（例如，在大型语言模型的情况下）、发布模型检查点，或采取其他适合所做研究的方式来保障。

sents.en: Depending on the contribution, reproducibility can be accomplished in various ways.
sents.zh: 根据贡献类型的不同，可以通过多种方式实现可复现性。

sents.en: For example, if the contribution is a novel architecture, describing the architecture fully might suffice, or if the contribution is a specific model and empirical evaluation, it may be necessary to either make it possible for others to replicate the model with the same dataset, or provide access to the model.
sents.zh: 例如，如果贡献是一种新架构，那么完整描述该架构可能就足够了；而如果贡献是一个具体的模型及其实证评估，则可能需要让他人能够使用相同的数据集复现该模型，或者提供对该模型的访问。

sents.en: In general. releasing code and data is often one good way to accomplish this, but reproducibility can also be provided via detailed instructions for how to replicate the results, access to a hosted model (e.g., in the case of a large language model), releasing of a model checkpoint, or other means that are appropriate to the research performed.
sents.zh: 一般来说，发布代码和数据通常是实现这一目标的一种好方法，但可复现性也可以通过提供如何复现结果的详细说明、提供托管模型的访问方式（例如，在大型语言模型的情况下）、发布模型检查点，或采取其他适合所做研究的方式来保障。

paragraphs.en: While NeurIPS does not require releasing code, the conference does require all submissions to provide some reasonable avenue for reproducibility, which may depend on the nature of the contribution. For example
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 NeurIPS 不要求发布代码，但会议确实要求所有投稿提供某种合理的可复现性途径，这可能取决于贡献的性质。例如

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is primarily a new algorithm, the paper should make it clear how to reproduce that algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献主要是一种新算法，论文应明确说明如何复现该算法。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is primarily a new model architecture, the paper should describe the architecture clearly and fully.
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献主要是一种新的模型架构，论文应清晰而完整地描述该架构。

paragraphs.en: If the contribution is a new model (e.g., a large language model), then there should either be a way to access this model for reproducing the results or a way to reproduce the model (e.g., with an open-source dataset or instructions for how to construct the dataset).
paragraphs.zh: 如果贡献是新模型（例如，一个大语言模型），那么应当提供一种访问该模型以复现结果的方式，或提供一种复现该模型的方式（例如，使用开源数据集或如何构建该数据集的说明）。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility. In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，在某些情况下可复现性可能比较棘手，在这种情况下，欢迎作者描述他们为支持复现而采用的特定方式。 对于闭源模型，对模型的访问可能在某种程度上受限（例如，仅限注册用户），但其他研究者仍应有可能通过某种途径来复现或验证结果。

sents.en: We recognize that reproducibility may be tricky in some cases, in which case authors are welcome to describe the particular way they provide for reproducibility.
sents.zh: 我们认识到，在某些情况下可复现性可能比较棘手，在这种情况下，欢迎作者描述他们为支持复现而采用的特定方式。

sents.en: In the case of closed-source models, it may be that access to the model is limited in some way (e.g., to registered users), but it should be possible for other researchers to have some path to reproducing or verifying the results.
sents.zh: 对于闭源模型，对模型的访问可能在某种程度上受限（例如，仅限注册用户），但其他研究者仍应有可能通过某种途径来复现或验证结果。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否按照补充材料中的描述，开放了数据和代码的访问权限，并提供足够的说明以忠实地复现主要实验结果？

paragraphs.en: Justification: Code and reproduction instructions are available at https://github.com/00why00/S2RL . Released datasets and policy weights are linked from the repository and hosted at https://huggingface.co/0why0/S2RL . The README covers data preparation, training-set construction, and downstream evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：代码与复现说明可在 https://github.com/00why00/S2RL 获取。 已发布的数据集与策略权重通过代码仓库链接，托管于 https://huggingface.co/0why0/S2RL 。 README 涵盖数据准备、训练集构建与下游评估。

sents.en: Justification: Code and reproduction instructions are available at https://github.com/00why00/S2RL .
sents.zh: 理由：代码与复现说明可在 https://github.com/00why00/S2RL 获取。

sents.en: Released datasets and policy weights are linked from the repository and hosted at https://huggingface.co/0why0/S2RL .
sents.zh: 已发布的数据集与策略权重通过代码仓库链接，托管于 https://huggingface.co/0why0/S2RL 。

sents.en: The README covers data preparation, training-set construction, and downstream evaluation.
sents.zh: README 涵盖数据准备、训练集构建与下游评估。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that paper does not include experiments requiring code.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不包含需要代码的实验。

paragraphs.en: Please see the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 NeurIPS 代码与数据提交指南（ https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ）以了解更多详细信息。

paragraphs.en: While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so [No] is an acceptable answer. Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark).
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据，但我们理解这有时可能无法做到，因此回答 [No]（否）是可以接受的。 仅因论文未包含代码而将其拒稿是不允许的，除非代码是该贡献的核心（例如，针对一个新的开源基准）。

sents.en: While we encourage the release of code and data, we understand that this might not be possible, so [No] is an acceptable answer.
sents.zh: 虽然我们鼓励发布代码和数据，但我们理解这有时可能无法做到，因此回答 [No]（否）是可以接受的。

sents.en: Papers cannot be rejected simply for not including code, unless this is central to the contribution (e.g., for a new open-source benchmark).
sents.zh: 仅因论文未包含代码而将其拒稿是不允许的，除非代码是该贡献的核心（例如，针对一个新的开源基准）。

paragraphs.en: The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results. See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
paragraphs.zh: 说明中应包含复现结果所需运行的确切命令和环境。 更多细节请参阅 NeurIPS 代码与数据提交指南（ https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ）。

sents.en: The instructions should contain the exact command and environment needed to run to reproduce the results.
sents.zh: 说明中应包含复现结果所需运行的确切命令和环境。

sents.en: See the NeurIPS code and data submission guidelines ( https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ) for more details.
sents.zh: 更多细节请参阅 NeurIPS 代码与数据提交指南（ https://neurips.cc/public/guides/CodeSubmissionPolicy ）。

paragraphs.en: The authors should provide instructions on data access and preparation, including how to access the raw data, preprocessed data, intermediate data, and generated data, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应提供关于数据访问和准备的说明，包括如何访问原始数据、预处理数据、中间数据和生成数据等。

paragraphs.en: The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines. If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应提供脚本，以复现新提出的方法和基线的所有实验结果。 如果只有部分实验可复现，作者应说明哪些实验未包含在脚本中以及原因。

sents.en: The authors should provide scripts to reproduce all experimental results for the new proposed method and baselines.
sents.zh: 作者应提供脚本，以复现新提出的方法和基线的所有实验结果。

sents.en: If only a subset of experiments are reproducible, they should state which ones are omitted from the script and why.
sents.zh: 如果只有部分实验可复现，作者应说明哪些实验未包含在脚本中以及原因。

paragraphs.en: At submission time, to preserve anonymity, the authors should release anonymized versions (if applicable).
paragraphs.zh: 提交时，为保持匿名性，作者应发布匿名版本（如适用）。

paragraphs.en: Providing as much information as possible in supplemental material (appended to the paper) is recommended, but including URLs to data and code is permitted.
paragraphs.zh: 建议在补充材料（附加在论文后面）中尽可能多地提供信息，但也允许提供数据和代码的 URL。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer) necessary to understand the results?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否规定了理解结果所需的全部训练和测试细节（例如：数据划分、超参数及其选择方式、优化器类型）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The experimental section describes the datasets, compression ratios, metrics, baselines, downstream training protocol, optimizer, crop size, and training schedule. The appendix further reports RL hyperparameters, reward computation details, downstream training details, and computational resource usage.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：实验部分描述了数据集、压缩率、指标、基线方法、下游训练协议、优化器、裁剪尺寸和训练计划。 附录进一步报告了强化学习超参数、奖励计算细节、下游训练细节以及计算资源使用情况。

sents.en: Justification: The experimental section describes the datasets, compression ratios, metrics, baselines, downstream training protocol, optimizer, crop size, and training schedule.
sents.zh: 理由：实验部分描述了数据集、压缩率、指标、基线方法、下游训练协议、优化器、裁剪尺寸和训练计划。

sents.en: The appendix further reports RL hyperparameters, reward computation details, downstream training details, and computational resource usage.
sents.zh: 附录进一步报告了强化学习超参数、奖励计算细节、下游训练细节以及计算资源使用情况。

paragraphs.en: The experimental setting should be presented in the core of the paper to a level of detail that is necessary to appreciate the results and make sense of them.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置应在论文的核心部分呈现，其详细程度应足以让读者理解并弄清这些结果。

paragraphs.en: The full details can be provided either with the code, in appendix, or as supplemental material.
paragraphs.zh: 完整细节可以通过随代码提供、放在附录中，或作为补充材料的方式给出。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否恰当地报告了误差棒并给出正确定义，或提供了关于实验统计显著性的其他适当信息？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The main comparisons report mean ± \pm standard deviation over five constructed sets and five student seeds per set. The appendix separately reports three independent policy runs, five-seed prototype ablations, and descriptive variation across five stored sets for semantic/layout diagnostics. The stored-set diagnostics are not treated as independent policy replications or significance tests.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：主要比较结果报告了在五个构建集合、每个集合五个学生随机种子上的均值 ± \pm 标准差。 附录单独报告了三次独立的策略运行、五个种子的原型消融实验，以及五个存储集合在语义/布局诊断上的描述性变异。 存储集合的诊断不被视为独立的策略重复实验或显著性检验。

sents.en: Justification: The main comparisons report mean ± \pm standard deviation over five constructed sets and five student seeds per set.
sents.zh: 理由：主要比较结果报告了在五个构建集合、每个集合五个学生随机种子上的均值 ± \pm 标准差。

sents.en: The appendix separately reports three independent policy runs, five-seed prototype ablations, and descriptive variation across five stored sets for semantic/layout diagnostics.
sents.zh: 附录单独报告了三次独立的策略运行、五个种子的原型消融实验，以及五个存储集合在语义/布局诊断上的描述性变异。

sents.en: The stored-set diagnostics are not treated as independent policy replications or significance tests.
sents.zh: 存储集合的诊断不被视为独立的策略重复实验或显著性检验。

paragraphs.en: The authors should answer [Yes] if the results are accompanied by error bars, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests, at least for the experiments that support the main claims of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 如果结果附有误差棒、置信区间或统计显著性检验，作者应回答 [Yes]，至少对于支持论文主要论点的实验应如此。

paragraphs.en: The factors of variability that the error bars are capturing should be clearly stated (for example, train/test split, initialization, random drawing of some parameter, or overall run with given experimental conditions).
paragraphs.zh: 误差棒所反映的变异因素应当被清楚地说明（例如，训练/测试集划分、初始化、某个参数的随机抽取，或在给定实验条件下的整体运行）。

paragraphs.en: The method for calculating the error bars should be explained (closed form formula, call to a library function, bootstrap, etc.)
paragraphs.zh: 误差棒的计算方法应当予以说明（闭式公式、调用库函数、自助法等）

paragraphs.en: The assumptions made should be given (e.g., Normally distributed errors).
paragraphs.zh: 应给出所作的假设（例如，误差服从正态分布）。

paragraphs.en: It should be clear whether the error bar is the standard deviation or the standard error of the mean.
paragraphs.zh: 应明确误差线表示的是标准差还是均值的标准误。

paragraphs.en: It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it. The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified.
paragraphs.zh: 可以报告 1-sigma 误差棒，但应当予以说明。 如果误差的正态性假设未经验证，作者最好报告 2-sigma 误差棒，而不是声称他们有 96% 的置信区间（CI）。

sents.en: It is OK to report 1-sigma error bars, but one should state it.
sents.zh: 可以报告 1-sigma 误差棒，但应当予以说明。

sents.en: The authors should preferably report a 2-sigma error bar than state that they have a 96% CI, if the hypothesis of Normality of errors is not verified.
sents.zh: 如果误差的正态性假设未经验证，作者最好报告 2-sigma 误差棒，而不是声称他们有 96% 的置信区间（CI）。

paragraphs.en: For asymmetric distributions, the authors should be careful not to show in tables or figures symmetric error bars that would yield results that are out of range (e.g., negative error rates).
paragraphs.zh: 对于非对称分布，作者应避免在表格或图中展示会产生超出范围结果（例如负错误率）的对称误差棒。

paragraphs.en: If error bars are reported in tables or plots, the authors should explain in the text how they were calculated and reference the corresponding figures or tables in the text.
paragraphs.zh: 如果误差条在表格或图中有所报告，作者应在文本中解释其计算方式，并在正文中引用相应的图或表。

paragraphs.en: Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于每个实验，论文是否提供了足够的信息来说明复现实验所需的计算机资源（计算工作节点的类型、内存、执行时间）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The appendix includes a computational resources table reporting construction cost and peak GPU memory for selection-based baselines, SD3.5, UniDD ∗ , and S 2 -RL. It also states the GPU type used for S 2 -RL fine-tuning and reports the training and inference costs needed to construct the distilled sets.
paragraphs.zh: 说明：附录中包含一个计算资源表，报告了基于选择的基线方法、SD3.5、UniDD ∗ 以及 S 2 -RL 的构建成本和峰值 GPU 显存。 该表还注明了用于 S 2 -RL 微调的 GPU 型号，并报告了构建蒸馏集所需的训练与推理成本。

sents.en: Justification: The appendix includes a computational resources table reporting construction cost and peak GPU memory for selection-based baselines, SD3.5, UniDD ∗ , and S 2 -RL.
sents.zh: 说明：附录中包含一个计算资源表，报告了基于选择的基线方法、SD3.5、UniDD ∗ 以及 S 2 -RL 的构建成本和峰值 GPU 显存。

sents.en: It also states the GPU type used for S 2 -RL fine-tuning and reports the training and inference costs needed to construct the distilled sets.
sents.zh: 该表还注明了用于 S 2 -RL 微调的 GPU 型号，并报告了构建蒸馏集所需的训练与推理成本。

paragraphs.en: The paper should indicate the type of compute workers CPU or GPU, internal cluster, or cloud provider, including relevant memory and storage.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应说明计算工作节点的类型，即 CPU 还是 GPU、内部集群还是云服务提供商，并包括相关的内存和存储信息。

paragraphs.en: The paper should provide the amount of compute required for each of the individual experimental runs as well as estimate the total compute.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应提供每个单独实验运行所需的计算量，并估算总计算量。

paragraphs.en: The paper should disclose whether the full research project required more compute than the experiments reported in the paper (e.g., preliminary or failed experiments that didn’t make it into the paper).
paragraphs.zh: 论文应说明完整的研究项目是否需要比论文中报告的实验更多的计算资源（例如，未能写入论文的初步实验或失败实验）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中开展的研究是否在各方面都符合 NeurIPS 道德准则 https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The work uses public datasets and pretrained models for semantic segmentation dataset distillation and does not involve human-subject experiments, private data collection, or harmful data acquisition. The study is conducted as a technical investigation of compact training set construction.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本工作使用公开数据集和预训练模型进行语义分割数据集蒸馏，不涉及人类受试者实验、私人数据收集或有害数据获取。 本研究是作为一项关于紧凑训练集构建的技术性调查开展的。

sents.en: Justification: The work uses public datasets and pretrained models for semantic segmentation dataset distillation and does not involve human-subject experiments, private data collection, or harmful data acquisition.
sents.zh: 理由：本工作使用公开数据集和预训练模型进行语义分割数据集蒸馏，不涉及人类受试者实验、私人数据收集或有害数据获取。

sents.en: The study is conducted as a technical investigation of compact training set construction.
sents.zh: 本研究是作为一项关于紧凑训练集构建的技术性调查开展的。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the authors have not reviewed the NeurIPS Code of Ethics.
paragraphs.zh: 回答 [N/A] 表示作者尚未审阅 NeurIPS 伦理准则（NeurIPS Code of Ethics）。

paragraphs.en: If the authors answer [No] , they should explain the special circumstances that require a deviation from the Code of Ethics.
paragraphs.zh: 如果作者回答[否]，则应说明需要偏离伦理准则的特殊情况。

paragraphs.en: The authors should make sure to preserve anonymity (e.g., if there is a special consideration due to laws or regulations in their jurisdiction).
paragraphs.zh: 作者应确保保持匿名性（例如，若因其所辖司法辖区的法律或法规而存在特殊考量）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否讨论了所做工作可能带来的积极社会影响和消极社会影响？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper discusses potential positive and negative societal impacts in Appendix. The positive impacts include reducing annotation, storage, and iteration costs for dense prediction research, while the negative impacts include possible inherited biases, artifacts, and pseudo-label errors from pretrained generative and segmentation models.
paragraphs.zh: 理由说明：论文在附录中讨论了潜在的正向社会影响和负向社会影响。 正面影响包括降低密集预测研究中标注、存储和迭代的成本，而负面影响包括从预训练的生成模型和分割模型中可能继承的偏见、伪影以及伪标签错误。

sents.en: Justification: The paper discusses potential positive and negative societal impacts in Appendix.
sents.zh: 理由说明：论文在附录中讨论了潜在的正向社会影响和负向社会影响。

sents.en: The positive impacts include reducing annotation, storage, and iteration costs for dense prediction research, while the negative impacts include possible inherited biases, artifacts, and pseudo-label errors from pretrained generative and segmentation models.
sents.zh: 正面影响包括降低密集预测研究中标注、存储和迭代的成本，而负面影响包括从预训练的生成模型和分割模型中可能继承的偏见、伪影以及伪标签错误。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that there is no societal impact of the work performed.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示所开展的工作不存在社会影响。

paragraphs.en: If the authors answer [N/A] or [No] , they should explain why their work has no societal impact or why the paper does not address societal impact.
paragraphs.zh: 如果作者回答 [N/A] 或 [No]，他们应解释为什么其工作没有社会影响，或为什么论文未涉及社会影响。

paragraphs.en: Examples of negative societal impacts include potential malicious or unintended uses (e.g., disinformation, generating fake profiles, surveillance), fairness considerations (e.g., deployment of technologies that could make decisions that unfairly impact specific groups), privacy considerations, and security considerations.
paragraphs.zh: 负面的社会影响示例包括潜在的恶意或无意使用（例如，虚假信息、生成虚假档案、监控）、公平性考量（例如，部署可能做出对特定群体产生不公平影响的技术）、隐私考量和安全考量。

paragraphs.en: The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments. However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out. For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation. On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.
paragraphs.zh: 会议预期许多论文将属于基础研究，并不与特定应用挂钩，更不用说部署了。 然而，如果存在通往任何负面应用的直接路径，作者应当指出这一点。 例如，指出生成模型质量的提升可能被用于生成虚假信息的深度伪造（Deepfakes），是合理的。 另一方面，没有必要指出一种用于优化神经网络的通用算法可能使人们能够更快地训练出生成深度伪造的模型。

sents.en: The conference expects that many papers will be foundational research and not tied to particular applications, let alone deployments.
sents.zh: 会议预期许多论文将属于基础研究，并不与特定应用挂钩，更不用说部署了。

sents.en: However, if there is a direct path to any negative applications, the authors should point it out.
sents.zh: 然而，如果存在通往任何负面应用的直接路径，作者应当指出这一点。

sents.en: For example, it is legitimate to point out that an improvement in the quality of generative models could be used to generate Deepfakes for disinformation.
sents.zh: 例如，指出生成模型质量的提升可能被用于生成虚假信息的深度伪造（Deepfakes），是合理的。

sents.en: On the other hand, it is not needed to point out that a generic algorithm for optimizing neural networks could enable people to train models that generate Deepfakes faster.
sents.zh: 另一方面，没有必要指出一种用于优化神经网络的通用算法可能使人们能够更快地训练出生成深度伪造的模型。

paragraphs.en: The authors should consider possible harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended and functioning correctly, harms that could arise when the technology is being used as intended but gives incorrect results, and harms following from (intentional or unintentional) misuse of the technology.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应考虑以下几类可能的危害：技术在使用符合预期且正常运行时可能产生的危害；技术在使用符合预期但给出错误结果时可能产生的危害；以及因（有意或无意的）技术滥用而导致的危害。

paragraphs.en: If there are negative societal impacts, the authors could also discuss possible mitigation strategies (e.g., gated release of models, providing defenses in addition to attacks, mechanisms for monitoring misuse, mechanisms to monitor how a system learns from feedback over time, improving the efficiency and accessibility of ML).
paragraphs.zh: 如果存在负面的社会影响，作者还可以讨论可能的缓解策略（例如，模型的门控发布、在提供攻击之外还提供防御措施、监控滥用的机制、监控系统如何随时间从反馈中学习的机制、提高机器学习的效率和可及性）。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否描述了为负责任地发布存在较高滥用风险的数据或模型（例如预训练语言模型、图像生成器或爬取的数据集）而设置的保障措施？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper does not release a new general-purpose image generator, scraped dataset, or high-risk pretrained model. The experiments rely on existing public datasets and pretrained models, and the generated samples are used for semantic segmentation dataset distillation evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文未发布新的通用图像生成器、爬取的数据集或高风险预训练模型。 实验依赖现有的公开数据集和预训练模型，生成的样本用于语义分割数据集蒸馏评估。

sents.en: Justification: The paper does not release a new general-purpose image generator, scraped dataset, or high-risk pretrained model.
sents.zh: 理由：本文未发布新的通用图像生成器、爬取的数据集或高风险预训练模型。

sents.en: The experiments rely on existing public datasets and pretrained models, and the generated samples are used for semantic segmentation dataset distillation evaluation.
sents.zh: 实验依赖现有的公开数据集和预训练模型，生成的样本用于语义分割数据集蒸馏评估。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper poses no such risks.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文不存在此类风险。

paragraphs.en: Released models that have a high risk for misuse or dual-use should be released with necessary safeguards to allow for controlled use of the model, for example by requiring that users adhere to usage guidelines or restrictions to access the model or implementing safety filters.
paragraphs.zh: 具有较高滥用或双重用途风险的已发布模型，应附带必要的安全保障措施以便对模型进行受控使用，例如要求用户遵守使用准则或访问限制才能使用模型，或实施安全过滤器。

paragraphs.en: Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks. The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images.
paragraphs.zh: 从互联网上抓取的数据集可能带来安全风险。 作者应说明他们是如何避免发布不安全图像的。

sents.en: Datasets that have been scraped from the Internet could pose safety risks.
sents.zh: 从互联网上抓取的数据集可能带来安全风险。

sents.en: The authors should describe how they avoided releasing unsafe images.
sents.zh: 作者应说明他们是如何避免发布不安全图像的。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that providing effective safeguards is challenging, and many papers do not require this, but we encourage authors to take this into account and make a best faith effort.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，提供有效的保障措施具有挑战性，而且许多论文并不要求这一点，但我们鼓励作者将其考虑在内并尽最大努力去做。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中使用的资产（例如代码、数据、模型）的创作者或原始所有者是否得到了恰当的署名，且是否明确提及并恰当遵守了许可证和使用条款？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper cites the datasets, pretrained models, and software frameworks used in the experiments, including ADE20K, COCO, Stable Diffusion 3.5, FreestyleNet, DINOv3, segmentation models, and MMSegmentation. We follow their intended research-use settings and provide code that relies on users obtaining the corresponding assets from their official sources and respecting their licenses.
paragraphs.zh: 依据说明：论文引用了实验中使用的数据集、预训练模型和软件框架，包括 ADE20K、COCO、Stable Diffusion 3.5、FreestyleNet、DINOv3、分割模型以及 MMSegmentation。 我们遵循这些资源的预期研究用途设定，并提供的代码依赖于用户从官方渠道获取相应资源并遵守其许可证。

sents.en: Justification: The paper cites the datasets, pretrained models, and software frameworks used in the experiments, including ADE20K, COCO, Stable Diffusion 3.5, FreestyleNet, DINOv3, segmentation models, and MMSegmentation.
sents.zh: 依据说明：论文引用了实验中使用的数据集、预训练模型和软件框架，包括 ADE20K、COCO、Stable Diffusion 3.5、FreestyleNet、DINOv3、分割模型以及 MMSegmentation。

sents.en: We follow their intended research-use settings and provide code that relies on users obtaining the corresponding assets from their official sources and respecting their licenses.
sents.zh: 我们遵循这些资源的预期研究用途设定，并提供的代码依赖于用户从官方渠道获取相应资源并遵守其许可证。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not use existing assets.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文未使用现有资产。

paragraphs.en: The authors should cite the original paper that produced the code package or dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应引用产生该代码包或数据集的原始论文。

paragraphs.en: The authors should state which version of the asset is used and, if possible, include a URL.
paragraphs.zh: 作者应说明使用的是资产的哪个版本，并尽可能提供 URL。

paragraphs.en: The name of the license (e.g., CC-BY 4.0) should be included for each asset.
paragraphs.zh: 每个资产都应注明许可证名称（例如 CC-BY 4.0）。

paragraphs.en: For scraped data from a particular source (e.g., website), the copyright and terms of service of that source should be provided.
paragraphs.zh: 对于从特定来源（如网站）抓取的数据，应提供该来源的版权和服务条款。

paragraphs.en: If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided. For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets. Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 如果发布资产，应提供包中的许可证、版权信息和使用条款。 对于流行数据集，paperswithcode.com/datasets 为部分数据集整理了许可证信息。 其许可证指南可以帮助确定数据集的许可证。

sents.en: If assets are released, the license, copyright information, and terms of use in the package should be provided.
sents.zh: 如果发布资产，应提供包中的许可证、版权信息和使用条款。

sents.en: For popular datasets, paperswithcode.com/datasets has curated licenses for some datasets.
sents.zh: 对于流行数据集，paperswithcode.com/datasets 为部分数据集整理了许可证信息。

sents.en: Their licensing guide can help determine the license of a dataset.
sents.zh: 其许可证指南可以帮助确定数据集的许可证。

paragraphs.en: For existing datasets that are re-packaged, both the original license and the license of the derived asset (if it has changed) should be provided.
paragraphs.zh: 对于重新打包的现有数据集，应同时提供原始许可证和衍生资产许可证（如有变更）。

paragraphs.en: If this information is not available online, the authors are encouraged to reach out to the asset’s creators.
paragraphs.zh: 如果这些信息无法在线获取，鼓励作者联系该资产的创建者。

paragraphs.en: Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文中引入的新资产是否有完善的文档记录，并且是否随资产一并提供文档？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The implementation is released at https://github.com/00why00/S2RL , with a README covering dependencies, data preparation, and commands for training-set construction and downstream evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：该实现已在 https://github.com/00why00/S2RL 发布，其中 README 涵盖了依赖项、数据准备，以及训练集构建和下游评估的命令。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not release new assets.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文未发布新资产。

paragraphs.en: Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates. This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员应在提交成果时通过结构化模板传达数据集/代码/模型的详细信息。 这包括有关训练、许可证、局限性等方面的细节。

sents.en: Researchers should communicate the details of the dataset/code/model as part of their submissions via structured templates.
sents.zh: 研究人员应在提交成果时通过结构化模板传达数据集/代码/模型的详细信息。

sents.en: This includes details about training, license, limitations, etc.
sents.zh: 这包括有关训练、许可证、局限性等方面的细节。

paragraphs.en: The paper should discuss whether and how consent was obtained from people whose asset is used.
paragraphs.zh: 论文应讨论是否以及如何从其资产被使用的人那里获得同意。

paragraphs.en: At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable). You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file.
paragraphs.zh: 提交时，请记得对你的资产进行匿名化处理（如适用）。 你可以创建一个匿名化的 URL，或者附上一个匿名化的 zip 文件。

sents.en: At submission time, remember to anonymize your assets (if applicable).
sents.zh: 提交时，请记得对你的资产进行匿名化处理（如适用）。

sents.en: You can either create an anonymized URL or include an anonymized zip file.
sents.zh: 你可以创建一个匿名化的 URL，或者附上一个匿名化的 zip 文件。

paragraphs.en: Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects
paragraphs.zh: 众包与人类受试者研究

paragraphs.en: Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：对于众包实验及涉及人类受试者的研究，论文是否包含（如适用情况下）提供给参与者的完整指导文本和截图，以及报酬细节（如有）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper does not involve crowdsourcing, user studies, or research with human subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：该论文不涉及众包、用户研究或以人类为对象的研究。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the paper does not involve crowdsourcing nor research with human subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示该论文既不涉及众包，也不涉及以人类为受试者的研究。

paragraphs.en: Including this information in the supplemental material is fine, but if the main contribution of the paper involves human subjects, then as much detail as possible should be included in the main paper.
paragraphs.zh: 将这些信息包含在补充材料中是可以的，但如果论文的主要贡献涉及人类受试者，则应在正文论文中尽可能详细地包含相关细节。

paragraphs.en: According to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics, workers involved in data collection, curation, or other labor should be paid at least the minimum wage in the country of the data collector.
paragraphs.zh: 根据 NeurIPS 伦理准则，参与数据收集、整理或其他劳动的工作人员，其报酬应不低于数据收集者所在国家的最低工资标准。

paragraphs.en: Institutional review board (IRB) approvals or equivalent for research with human subjects
paragraphs.zh: 机构审查委员会（IRB）批准或涉及人类受试者研究的等效许可

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained?
paragraphs.zh: 问题：论文是否描述了研究参与者可能承担的风险、此类风险是否已向受试者披露，以及是否获得了机构审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或基于您所在国家或机构要求的等效批准/审查）？

paragraphs.en: Justification: The paper does not involve human subjects, crowdsourcing, or collection of personal data, so IRB approval or equivalent human-subjects review is not applicable.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：本文不涉及人类受试者、众包或个人数据的收集，因此无需伦理审查委员会（IRB）批准或同等的人类受试者审查。

paragraphs.en: Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research. If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 根据开展研究所处的国家，任何涉及人类受试者的研究可能都需要获得机构审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或同等批准）。 如果你已获得机构审查委员会（IRB）的批准，应在论文中明确说明。

sents.en: Depending on the country in which research is conducted, IRB approval (or equivalent) may be required for any human subjects research.
sents.zh: 根据开展研究所处的国家，任何涉及人类受试者的研究可能都需要获得机构审查委员会（IRB）的批准（或同等批准）。

sents.en: If you obtained IRB approval, you should clearly state this in the paper.
sents.zh: 如果你已获得机构审查委员会（IRB）的批准，应在论文中明确说明。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that the procedures for this may vary significantly between institutions and locations, and we expect authors to adhere to the NeurIPS Code of Ethics and the guidelines for their institution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，相关流程可能因机构和地点的不同而有显著差异，我们期望作者遵守 NeurIPS 道德准则及其所在机构的指导方针。

paragraphs.en: For initial submissions, do not include any information that would break anonymity (if applicable), such as the institution conducting the review.
paragraphs.zh: 对于初次提交，请勿包含任何会破坏匿名性（如适用）的信息，例如进行评审的机构。

paragraphs.en: Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research? Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required.
paragraphs.zh: 问题：如果大语言模型（LLMs）是本研究的核心方法中重要、原创或非标准的组成部分，论文是否描述了其使用情况？ 请注意，如果大语言模型仅用于写作、编辑或排版目的，且不影响研究核心方法、科学严谨性或原创性，则无需声明。

sents.en: Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research?
sents.zh: 问题：如果大语言模型（LLMs）是本研究的核心方法中重要、原创或非标准的组成部分，论文是否描述了其使用情况？

sents.en: Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required.
sents.zh: 请注意，如果大语言模型仅用于写作、编辑或排版目的，且不影响研究核心方法、科学严谨性或原创性，则无需声明。

paragraphs.en: Justification: The core method does not use LLMs as an important, original, or non-standard component. Text prompts are constructed from semantic category names rather than generated or optimized by an LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 理由：核心方法并未将大语言模型作为重要的、原创的或非标准的组成部分。 文本提示词由语义类别名称构建而成，而非由大语言模型生成或优化。

sents.en: Justification: The core method does not use LLMs as an important, original, or non-standard component.
sents.zh: 理由：核心方法并未将大语言模型作为重要的、原创的或非标准的组成部分。

sents.en: Text prompts are constructed from semantic category names rather than generated or optimized by an LLM.
sents.zh: 文本提示词由语义类别名称构建而成，而非由大语言模型生成或优化。

paragraphs.en: The answer [N/A] means that the core method development in this research does not involve LLMs as any important, original, or non-standard components.
paragraphs.zh: 答案 [N/A] 表示本研究的核心方法开发并未将 LLM 作为任何重要的、原创的或非标准的组件。

paragraphs.en: Please refer to our LLM policy in the NeurIPS handbook for what should or should not be described.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 NeurIPS 手册中的大语言模型（LLM）政策，了解哪些内容应当描述、哪些不应描述。
